"title": "ARTICLE 1 - PURPOSE", "html": "<p>The purpose of the present Framework Agreement is to define the general terms and conditions to be applied each time Customer places an Order with the Supplier for the execution of the following Services:  <\/p><p>The uncertain and changing situation the Stellantis Group is living, as a global car manufacturer, is an opportunity to promote and adopt new tools based on data, digital solutions &amp; Lean/Agile methodologies at a Stellantis level. With constantly evolving and competitive markets and optimizing resources, it is also necessary to review how we animate our networks to be more efficient. <\/p><p>That is why, we are pursuing its transformation and launch a project which purpose is to change the way we collectively work. At the same time, Stellantis wants to strengthen the relationship between the brands and their network via a community platform called Business Community.<\/p><p>The main target of the new Digital backbone is to allow synergies, simplification and efficiency through a unique platform for dealers and field force with personalized contents to know very quickly what you need to know and what you have to do. Thus, this platform aims to replace existing tools and functionalities, which are today duplicate for several brands and countries. <\/p><p>This new digital platform will be at the same time a business social network, which will allow top-down and bottom-up communications and a digital workplace, which will improve the efficiency of the Stellantis Network Operations.  <\/p><p>To improve the productivity and the user experience, the provider will have to work on 3 pillars: All-in-1 tool, Daily life simplification, Use full power of last-generation software technologies. <\/p><p>It is hereby specified that signing the present Framework Agreement does not constitute any exclusivity to either of the Parties, and nothing will prevent Customer from entering into other or similar agreements with persons or entities other than Supplier for the provision of services that are similar or identical to the Services to be provided by Supplier. Moreover, the signature of this Framework Agreement does not constitute an obligation for Customer to place orders with the Supplier nor entrust the Supplier with the execution of Services. <\/p>", "text": "The purpose of the present Framework Agreement is to define the general terms and conditions to be applied each time Customer places an Order with the Supplier for the execution of the following Services:  \nThe uncertain and changing situation the Stellantis Group is living, as a global car manufacturer, is an opportunity to promote and adopt new tools based on data, digital solutions & Lean/Agile methodologies at a Stellantis level. With constantly evolving and competitive markets and optimizing resources, it is also necessary to review how we animate our networks to be more efficient. \nThat is why, we are pursuing its transformation and launch a project which purpose is to change the way we collectively work. At the same time, Stellantis wants to strengthen the relationship between the brands and their network via a community platform called Business Community.\nThe main target of the new Digital backbone is to allow synergies, simplification and efficiency through a unique platform for dealers and field force with personalized contents to know very quickly what you need to know and what you have to do. Thus, this platform aims to replace existing tools and functionalities, which are today duplicate for several brands and countries. \nThis new digital platform will be at the same time a business social network, which will allow top-down and bottom-up communications and a digital workplace, which will improve the efficiency of the Stellantis Network Operations.  \nTo improve the productivity and the user experience, the provider will have to work on 3 pillars: All-in-1 tool, Daily life simplification, Use full power of last-generation software technologies. \nIt is hereby specified that signing the present Framework Agreement does not constitute any exclusivity to either of the Parties, and nothing will prevent Customer from entering into other or similar agreements with persons or entities other than Supplier for the provision of services that are similar or identical to the Services to be provided by Supplier. Moreover, the signature of this Framework Agreement does not constitute an obligation for Customer to place orders with the Supplier nor entrust the Supplier with the execution of Services. "}, {"id": "d0-s11", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 2 - DEFINITIONS", "html": "<p>The following capitalized terms, whether used in the singular or in the plural form, shall have the meaning set forth below. <\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Affiliates<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong> means any corporation or other legal entity directly or indirectly Controlling or Controlled by or under common Control with Customer, where “Control” means with respect to Customer: (i) the direct or indirect ownership of a fraction of the share capital that gives a majority of the voting rights at that company’s relevant shareholders meetings; (ii) the ownership of the majority of the voting rights in that company by virtue of an agreement entered into with other shareholders or suppliers; (iii) the effective right to determine the decisions taken at that company’s relevant shareholders meetings; or (iv) other rights to direct the management of that company. Any company in which one or several company(ies) of Stellantis Group own(s) at least 50% of the capital share capital, shall be deemed an Affiliate.<\/p><p><strong>“Agreement” <\/strong>or<strong> “Framework Agreement” <\/strong>refers to the present agreement, its appendices and/or schedules and amendments<strong>.  <\/strong><\/p><p><strong>“Anti-Corruption Laws”<\/strong> means all applicable laws and regulations, as amended or replaced from time to time in connection with bribery, corruption, money laundering and anti-terrorism financing including, but not limited to: <\/p><p>The French law of 9 December 2016 referred to as the “Loi Sapin II” together with all other relevant French laws relations to corruption, anti-money laundering or anti-terrorism, <\/p><p>The United States Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, <\/p><p>The OECD Convention on Combating Bribery of Foreign Public Officials in International Business Transactions, <\/p><p>The United Kingdom Bribery Act 2010, and<\/p><p>Any local law applying to the Supplier, if applicable<\/p><p>“<strong>Authorized Third Party<\/strong>” means Customer’s Affiliates and any service provider acting in the name and/or behalf of Customer or its Affiliates, as well as Customer’s or its Affiliates’ ‘clients if Customer or Affiliates provide IT services to such clients (e.g. dealer network, etc.).  <\/p><p>“<strong>Background<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong><strong> <\/strong>means all the technical and/or scientific information and knowledge of any nature, including but not limited to any know-how, specific trade secrets, commercial secrets, data, databases, software, files, plans, diagrams, drawings, formulas, and/or any other types of information or knowledge, using any medium and in any form, whether protected or not and/or protectable or not under Intellectual Property Rights, which are owned or held by a Party, prior to the date of entry into force of the terms of the Agreement and/or developed or acquired by that Party after said date but independently and outside the scope of this Agreement.<\/p><p><strong>“Corrupt Act”<\/strong> means: <\/p><p>Any payment, gift or other provisions of thing of value that: <\/p><p>Violates any Anti-Corruption Laws, or<\/p><p>Was made with corrupt intent to or for the benefit of a Public Official or private person with the intention of influencing such Public Official or private person to obtain or retain an improper business or advantage, or<\/p><p>Knowingly (i) falsifying books, records and accounts; or (ii) circumventing internal controls in violation of Anti-Corruption Laws or in furtherance of and act identified in subsection a) (ii). <\/p><p><strong>“CSR Rules”<\/strong> means the relevant national, European and international rules related to ethical and responsible standards of behaviour, including, without limitation, standards dealing with human rights, the protection of the environment, human health, the safety of persons and sustainable development, as amended, supplemented or substituted from time to time. <\/p><p>“<strong>Customer<\/strong>” means the legal entity belonging to Stellantis Group beneficiary of the Services executing the Agreement and/or any other legal entity belonging to Stellantis Group issuing an Order<\/p><p>“<strong>Customer Cybersecurity Rules<\/strong>” means all the rules that the Supplier must comply with while executing the Services. They are described in Appendix III to the present Agreement. <\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Data<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong> means any information, whatever their nature (including Personal Data), protected or not by an Intellectual Property Right or by a non-disclosure obligation, and whatever their form, collected, processed, generated, stored and operated by Customer or its Affiliates or one of its data processors on its behalf, and made available to or generated by the Supplier for the needs of the execution of Services. <\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Deliverables<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong> means all the elements referred to as such in the Technical Appendix, the Agreement and more generally any Result or element, of any nature and in any form, (including any modification of such elements) and including in particular, but not limited to, any computer program, set of parameters, source codes, object codes, applications, websites, databases, data, or elements allowing data migration, etc., which Supplier shall deliver to Customer while performing all or part of a Service, as well as any Documentation relative thereto.<\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Documentation<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong> means all the documents, of any nature and in any form, relating to the Deliverables , including but not limited to any preparatory design work, any analytical and/or programming documents, any installation and setting instructions and/or instructions for use, any training documentation, any descriptions and technical, functional and/or interoperability specifications, etc.<\/p><p>&quot;<strong>Effective Date<\/strong>&quot;: means the date of entry into force of this Agreement it being the latest date of signature of this Agreement<\/p><p><strong>“Export Control Laws”<\/strong> means all Sanctions and export control laws and regulations of the European Union and the United States of America and any other applicable jurisdiction, as amended, supplemented or substituted from time to time. <\/p><p><strong>“Force Majeure Event”<\/strong> means an external and irresistible event or occurrence, unforeseeable at the time of signature of the Agreement and beyond the reasonable control of such Party, without such Party’s fault or negligence, including, but not limited to, and provided that the event satisfies the above conditions : legal or government restrictions, malicious acts of third parties, which could not be reasonably expected to be avoided, fires, floods, windstorms, explosions, riots, natural disasters, worldwide pandemic.<\/p><p><strong>“Foreground” <\/strong>means Intellectual Property Rights coming into existence during the term of this Agreement as a consequence of and with reference to the performance of the Services. In case  the Supplier uses a subcontractor, the Supplier undertakes to obtain the assignment to the Customer of the Intellectual Property Rights attached to the Foreground generated by such subcontractors.<\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Functional and Technical Specifications<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong><strong> <\/strong>means the needs of Customer and the various functional results expected of the Deliverable(s) under the terms of the Service (functionalities, levels of performance, quantities, quality, costs, durations, deadlines…), the technical conditions under which such results must be achieved and verifiable as well as Customer’s own constraints (technical, administrative, etc…) which the Customer shall take into account. Such Functional and Technical Specifications are detailed in Appendix I “Technical Appendix” and, as the case may be, in each Statement of Work and shall prevail over any Documentation or more generally over any document not expressly accepted by Customer.<\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Further Data Processor<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong> means the subcontractor which the Supplier - acting as personal data processor of Customer (according to the definition included in the European Regulation set out below), may use to carry out specific Personal Data processing activities.<\/p><p><strong>“Intellectual Property Rights” <\/strong>means any and all rights in any invention, discovery, improvement, patent, copyright, design, mask work right or circuit layout right, and any and all rights of whatever nature in computer software and data, trade secrets, know-how, drawings, specifications, documents, plans, reports, diagrams and other data that has been reduced to writing (whether in physical or electronic form), and any and all intangible rights and privileges of a nature similar to any of the foregoing, in every case in any part of the world and whether or not registered, and shall include all rights in any applications and granted applications for any of the foregoing.<\/p><p><strong>“Open Source Software”<\/strong>: means any software corresponding to the requirements defined in the «Open Source Definition» (available on the URL: http://opensource.org/osd) by the Open Source Initiative, or by the «Free Software Foundation» (available on the URL: http://www.fsf.org/?set_language=fr), which Supplier declares to have read and understood.<\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Order<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong><strong> <\/strong>means the administrative document issued by Customer or by an Affiliate for the purpose of placing a purchase order with the Supplier for the execution of a Service, based on this Agreement and/or a Statement of Work and triggering the invoicing process for the Services. <\/p><p><strong>“Personal Data”<\/strong> means all the Data which identify directly or indirectly a natural person. Such definition includes personal data within the meaning of European Regulation No 2016/679 dated 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data (General Data Protection Regulation - GDPR) (hereinafter the « <strong>European Regulation<\/strong> ») and any other relevant applicable legislation.<\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Customer <\/strong><strong>Technical Environment<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong> means all the components of Customer’s information systems (architectures, equipment, networks, software, etc.), as described in Appendix I “Technical Appendix” and, as the case may be, in each Service Request Form, which Supplier undertakes to take into account in executing the Service. <\/p><p><strong>“Public Official”<\/strong> means any person (whether appointed or elected) holding a legislative, administrative, or judicial office, including any person employed by or acting on behalf of a public agency, a public enterprise (including any officer or employer of a state-operated entity) or a public international organisation. <\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Results<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong><strong> <\/strong>means all the knowledge resulting from the performance of this Framework Agreement and of each related Service Request Form, in particular any work (including any software in its object code version and source code version, database), any creation, any database, any invention, any data model, any algorithm whether or not written using software, the Deliverables, any specification, information, know-how, knowledge or process, or product and any resulting process, whether or not it can be protected and/or protectable by an intellectual property right and all the rights attached thereto, in any form, of any nature and in any medium, designed and executed by one or several Parties and/or their subcontractors under this Framework Agreement and each related Service Request Form. In case of a Party using a subcontractor, the said Party undertakes to obtain the assignment of the intellectual property rights attached to the Results generated by such subcontractors.<\/p><p><strong>“Sanctions”<\/strong> means any laws, regulations or restrictive measures (including, for the avoidance of doubt, any sanctions or measures relating to any particular embargo or asset freezing), each as amended, supplemented or substituted from time to time, administered, imposed or enforced by any Sanctions Authority. <\/p><p><strong>“Sanctions Authority”<\/strong> means (i) the United Nations Security Council; (ii) the French government; (iii) the European Union; (iv) the United States government; (v) the United Kingdom government; (vi) the respective governmental institutions and agencies of the foregoing, including without limitation, the Office of Foreign Asset Control of the US Department of Treasury (“OFAC”), the United States Department of State and Department of Commerce; and (vii) any other governmental institution or agency with responsibility for imposing, administering or enforcing the Sanctions with the jurisdictions over any Party. <\/p><p><strong>“Sanctions List”<\/strong> means the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons list maintained by OFAC, the Denied Persons list maintained by the US Department of Commerce, the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, or any other list issued or maintained by any Sanctions Authorities of persons subject to Sanctions (including investment or related restrictions), each as amended, supplemented or substituted from time to time. <\/p><p><strong>“Sanctioned Person”<\/strong> means a person- or an entity that is listed on, or owned or controlled by, or acting on behalf of, a person or an entity listed on any Sanctions list. <\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Service<\/strong><strong>”<\/strong><strong> <\/strong>or<strong> “Services”<\/strong> means any services (including, but not limited to, any services relating to consultancy, assistance, support, expertise, design, implementation, development, parameterizing, integration, hosting and/or maintenance, in the IT field) as identified in Technical Appendix, and as requested, as the case may be with a Statement of Work to be executed by Supplier under the present Agreement.<\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Statement of Work<\/strong><strong>” <\/strong>or<strong> “SOW”<\/strong><strong> <\/strong>means the agreement entered into by Customer or an Affiliate and Supplier under this Framework Agreement, defining the specific terms of each Service. It is hereby agreed by the Parties that all the provisions of the Framework Agreement shall apply to each SOW. Each SOW, as the case may be, could have a Technical Appendix and a Financial Appendix including specific Fees, considerations and penalties for the relevant Services ordered     <\/p><p>“<strong>Stellantis<\/strong><strong> Group<\/strong>” means the group of companies controlled by Stellantis N.V. with its registered office in Taurusavenue 1, 2132 LS, Hoofddorp, The Netherlands.<\/p><p><strong>“<\/strong><strong>Stellantis<\/strong><strong>’ Code of Conduct”<\/strong> means Stellantis’ code of conduct policy available at the following web address, as such may be amended by Customer from time to time: https://www.stellantis.com/content/dam/stellantis-corporate/group/governance/corporate-regulations/Stellantis_CoC_EN.pdf.<\/p><p>“<strong>Termination Transition Period<\/strong>” means up to twelve (12) month period of time following any termination or expiration of this Agreement. Consequently, unless otherwise explicitly agreed under the relevant Statement of Work the provisions of this Framework Agreement shall prevail over the Statement of Work.<\/p><p>To order Services under this Agreement: (i) either Customer or an Affiliate must issue to Supplier a properly authorized Order in accordance with the Technical Appendix and with the Financial Appendix attached herein or (ii) as otherwise agreed to by the Parties, if required by specific characteristics of the Services, an authorized representative of each Party or of its Affiliates (as the case may be) shall execute a Statement of Work describing the specific Services, the applicable service levels and the relevant  Functional and Technical Specifications, including the relevant Fees for such Services. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Statements of Work are not intended to re-open or re-negotiate the terms of this Agreement. The Statement of Work shall in any case always be followed by an Order, issued by the relevant Customer or Affiliate executing such Statement of Work.<\/p><p>It is understood between the parties that each SOW will incorporate by reference the terms and conditions of this Agreement, including all exhibits hereto. Consequently, unless otherwise explicitly agreed under the relevant Statement of Work the provisions of this Framework Agreement shall prevail over the Statement of Work.\nTo order Services under this Agreement: (i) either Customer or an Affiliate must issue to Supplier a properly authorized Order in accordance with the Technical Appendix and with the Financial Appendix attached herein or (ii) as otherwise agreed to by the Parties, if required by specific characteristics of the Services, an authorized representative of each Party or of its Affiliates (as the case may be) shall execute a Statement of Work describing the specific Services, the applicable service levels and the relevant  Functional and Technical Specifications, including the relevant Fees for such Services. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Statements of Work are not intended to re-open or re-negotiate the terms of this Agreement. The Statement of Work shall in any case always be followed by an Order, issued by the relevant Customer or Affiliate executing such Statement of Work.\nIt is understood between the parties that each SOW will incorporate by reference the terms and conditions of this Agreement, including all exhibits hereto. Obligations inherent in the execution of the Services", "html": "<p>The Supplier undertakes to:  <\/p><p>Execute all the Services and, where applicable, deliver the Deliverables in accordance with the terms and conditions defined in this Agreement and its attachments;  <\/p><p>Ensure that the staff assigned to the execution of the Services are readily available, experienced, competent and qualified; <\/p><p>Appoint from among its staff a project manager to be Customer’s preferred contact person; the project manager is required to be available and shall be vested with decision-making powers regarding the Services; <\/p><p>Provide the Functional and Technical Specifications in accordance with Customer’s requests and supply the Deliverables to be accepted by Customer in accordance with the terms referred to in each Technical Appendix; <\/p><p>Provide Customer with information, and advise Customer, in the best interests of Customer and/or its Affiliates, on the Services and the Deliverables, in particular on Customer’s technical environment and in such manner as to ensure that the Services and the Deliverables match the needs expressed by Customer;  <\/p><p>Notify Customer immediately and in writing of any elements, events or difficulties of which it may be aware and which do or may adversely affect the fair execution, the quality or performance of the Services and/or the Deliverables, it being specified that such notification shall under no circumstances entitle Supplier to relieve itself from liability <em>vis-à-vis<\/em> Customer, and communicate to Customer the solutions making it possible to execute the Services under the conditions agreed to by the Parties;  <\/p><p>Submit to Customer an estimate and a time frame for the execution of any additional services which may be necessary prior to the completion of the Services, taking into account that such services shall not be executed without prior written agreement by Customer; <\/p><p>Provide the Services in compliance with Customer Cybersecurity rules, in accordance with the provisions referred to in Appendix III “Customer Cybersecurity Rules” attached to this Agreement;<\/p><p>Execute the Services and provide the Deliverables in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, also with reference – where applicable – to website and apps accessibility guidelines pursuant to applicable local laws and regulations, in accordance with the technical requirements described in the Technical Appendix;<\/p><p>Inform Customer without undue delay of any occurrence likely to affect the execution of its Services within the prescribed time limits; it being understood that the transfer of such information shall not release Supplier from its obligations vis-à-vis Customer.  \nEnsure that the staff assigned to the execution of the Services are readily available, experienced, competent and qualified; \nAppoint from among its staff a project manager to be Customer’s preferred contact person; the project manager is required to be available and shall be vested with decision-making powers regarding the Services; \nProvide the Functional and Technical Specifications in accordance with Customer’s requests and supply the Deliverables to be accepted by Customer in accordance with the terms referred to in each Technical Appendix; \nProvide Customer with information, and advise Customer, in the best interests of Customer and/or its Affiliates, on the Services and the Deliverables, in particular on Customer’s technical environment and in such manner as to ensure that the Services and the Deliverables match the needs expressed by Customer;  \nNotify Customer immediately and in writing of any elements, events or difficulties of which it may be aware and which do or may adversely affect the fair execution, the quality or performance of the Services and/or the Deliverables, it being specified that such notification shall under no circumstances entitle Supplier to relieve itself from liability vis-à-vis Customer, and communicate to Customer the solutions making it possible to execute the Services under the conditions agreed to by the Parties;  \nSubmit to Customer an estimate and a time frame for the execution of any additional services which may be necessary prior to the completion of the Services, taking into account that such services shall not be executed without prior written agreement by Customer; \nProvide the Services in compliance with Customer Cybersecurity rules, in accordance with the provisions referred to in Appendix III “Customer Cybersecurity Rules” attached to this Agreement;\nExecute the Services and provide the Deliverables in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, also with reference – where applicable – to website and apps accessibility guidelines pursuant to applicable local laws and regulations, in accordance with the technical requirements described in the Technical Appendix;\nInform Customer without undue delay of any occurrence likely to affect the execution of its Services within the prescribed time limits; it being understood that the transfer of such information shall not release Supplier from its obligations vis-à-vis Customer. Economic independency", "html": "<p>The Supplier undertakes to take appropriate measures so as not to become overly dependant on Customer, in particular with respect to its economic situation. It acknowledges that it is its responsibility to seek to diversify its activities. Consequently, it undertakes to inform Customer in writing, should the turnover resulting from the sale of products or services (including the Services) to Customer and/or its Affiliates represent more than 30% of its total annual turnover. Should such limit be reached, the Parties agree to meet for the purpose of seeking solutions to preserve their respective interests. <\/p>", "text": "The Supplier undertakes to take appropriate measures so as not to become overly dependant on Customer, in particular with respect to its economic situation. Should such limit be reached, the Parties agree to meet for the purpose of seeking solutions to preserve their respective interests. "}, {"id": "d0-s15", "doc": 0, "title": "4.1.3. Staff executing the Services", "html": "<p>All the staff of Supplier assigned in part or in whole to the execution of the Services shall remain, under all circumstances, under the sole hierarchical and disciplinary authority of the Supplier who shall solely be responsible for their administrative management and social security contributions. <\/p><p>The Supplier shall solely determine, on the basis of their experience and qualifications, which salaried employees it wishes to assign to the execution of the Services, but it undertakes to assign to such execution an appropriate number of staff members specifically trained under its responsibility for that purpose. For the whole duration of the Agreement, the Supplier shall monitor and provide continuous training for its employees in order to maintain a degree of competence consistent with their field of expertise and at the levels required to execute the Services. <\/p><p>Furthermore, for the purpose of ensuring the sustainability and stability necessary to the implementation of any IT processing project, Supplier undertakes to ensure the sustainability and stability of the members of its staff assigned to the execution of each Service. On this basis, Supplier shall solely assume responsibility for any failure to comply, lack of availability or absence of the said members of its staff, and therefore shall inform Customer in writing immediately upon being appraised of any such occurrence and shall take any measures necessary to ensure the sustainability of the Services with the same quality requirements and time frame. <\/p><p>It is understood by the Parties that in case of replacement, for whatever the reason, of a member of Supplier’s staff assigned to the Service, the Supplier commits, at its own costs, to ensure a recovery period between the departing person and the new one, in order to make the new person at the same level of information and skills as the departing person (knowledge of the project, knowledge of the tasks achieved and the tasks to be achieved, knowledge of the Customer’s environment etc.). The duration of such recovery period will be agreed in the Technical Appendix. Customer will be able to apply the penalties set out in the Appendix II “Financial Appendix” in case of failure by the Supplier to comply with this obligation.<\/p><p>Should it prove necessary to replace one of the members of its staff assigned to the execution of each Service (including its project manager) the Supplier shall inform Customer without undue delay and promptly replace the departing member of staff with a new member of staff with a similar background in terms of skills and experience. The Supplier acknowledges and accepts that Customer may object to the choice of any new member of staff, if it deems that the latter lacks any of the skills and experience required for executing the Services. GOVERNANCE", "html": "<p>The follow-up and governance terms for monitoring the progress of the Services and verifying their compliance with the contract documents, are set out, where applicable, in the Article « Governance » inside the Technical Appendix or in the relevant SOW. <\/p><p>Except otherwise agreed by the Parties or any provisions to the contrary set out in the Technical Appendix, at the end of each month, the Supplier shall submit an activity report in respect of the Services executed during the past month to the project manager appointed by Customer for stamped approval.  <\/p><p>Such report shall include the detail of all the actions executed by Supplier in the course of the past month, laying out any actions still to be implemented, as well as any information useful to Customer for monitoring the progress of the Services and verifying their compliance with the set standards.<\/p><p>The Customer project manager shall inform the Supplier of all its remarks and observations regarding the Services thus executed.  <\/p><p>The Supplier undertakes, within the timeframe provided for in the Agreement and Technical Appendix or, failing this, within a period not exceeding 7 calendar days from the delivery of observations by Customer to: <\/p><p>confirm in writing to Customer that the observations made by the Customer project manager have been taken into account regarding the further execution of the Services,<\/p><p>submit to Customer all the supporting documents substantiating the taking into account of the said observations, <\/p><p> under its obligation to advise and inform, alert Customer about any potential consequences of said observations regarding the further execution of the Services, provide Customer with any useful recommendations and suggest an alternative solution,<\/p><p>correct any non-compliance of the Services with respect to the contract documents observed by Customer, and of which Supplier has been informed by means of such observations (other than the written observations made with respect to the activity report referred to above). <\/p><p>In case of non-compliance by the Supplier with the deadlines referred to above, Customer reserves the right to terminate the Agreement for breach invoking the liability of Supplier, according to Article 12.1, without prejudice to the right of Customer to seek damages or Price", "html": "<p>The prices agreed for the Services (including the build of, and where applicable exclusive licence to, the Services) hereinafter the “Fees”:<\/p><p>  - are to be understood exclusive of tax and the applicable VAT rate shall be that in force at the billing date. <\/p><p>- include any expenses, disbursements, travel expenses, supplies, charges and obligations whatever their nature and are deemed to take into account any specific feature or circumstances pertaining to the Services, in particular any means used or likely to be used by Supplier during the execution of the Services; In case travel expenses are agreed not to be included and invoiced separately by Supplier, such invoicing shall be according to the Customer’s Travel Policy which will be shared from time to time by Customer. In such case travel expenses shall be approved in advance in writing by the Customer.<\/p><p>- include, where applicable, the price of the assignment and/or the licence in respect of the Intellectual Property Rights pertaining to the Results and Deliverables, in accordance with the provisions of Article 7 « Intellectual Property» below and of the corresponding Statement of Work.<\/p><p>Supplier may not request the payment of any additional amount except where proven that such amounts are in respect of additional requests expressly made by Customer in writing. The financial terms and the billing schedule for the Services are set out in the Financial Appendix, and where applicable in the relevant Financial Appendix attached to the specific SOW.  <\/p><p>Supplier shall apply annual rebates as set out in the Financial Appendix, and where applicable in the relevant Financial Appendix attached to the specific SOW<\/p>", "text": "The prices agreed for the Services (including the build of, and where applicable exclusive licence to, the Services) hereinafter the “Fees”:\n  - are to be understood exclusive of tax and the applicable VAT rate shall be that in force at the billing date. \n- include any expenses, disbursements, travel expenses, supplies, charges and obligations whatever their nature and are deemed to take into account any specific feature or circumstances pertaining to the Services, in particular any means used or likely to be used by Supplier during the execution of the Services; In case travel expenses are agreed not to be included and invoiced separately by Supplier, such invoicing shall be according to the Customer’s Travel Policy which will be shared from time to time by Customer. Payment terms", "html": "<p>In order to be payable, Supplier’s invoices must show the Order number issued and have to be sent to the billing address specified in the corresponding Order(s).<\/p><p>  Supplier’s invoices are payable in 60 (sixty) calendar days.<\/p><p>In case of late payment by Customer, Supplier shall notify in writing Customer of such late payment. If Customer does not proceed with the payment of undisputed amounts within 30 days from the receipt of such written notice, then Supplier shall be entitled to apply to Customer, after due date, a penalty, applicable on the overdue amount at an annual rate of four percent (4%). If such interest rate exceeds the maximum legal rate permitted in the jurisdiction where a claim therefore is being asserted, the interest rate shall be reduced to the applicable maximum legal rate. In addition to this penalty, Supplier will be entitled to obtain from Customer a recovery cost amounting to no more than 40 (forty) Euros.  <\/p><p>If Customer, in good faith, disputes any element of the invoiced Fees, Customer may withhold from its payment of the relevant invoice any of these disputed amounts.  Customer may dispute any Fee or other charge by communicating to Supplier in writing Customer’s questions regarding, or objection to, the Fee or charge. <\/p><p>  Neither the failure to dispute any invoiced amounts prior to payment, nor the failure to withhold any amount, constitutes, operates, or may be construed as a waiver of any right Customer may otherwise have to dispute any amount charged on an invoice, or to recover any amount previously paid. Customer cannot dispute any invoiced Fees after the end of a period of six (6) months following the date of the invoice. <\/p>", "text": "In order to be payable, Supplier’s invoices must show the Order number issued and have to be sent to the billing address specified in the corresponding Order(s).\n  Supplier’s invoices are payable in 60 (sixty) calendar days.\nIn case of late payment by Customer, Supplier shall notify in writing Customer of such late payment. If such interest rate exceeds the maximum legal rate permitted in the jurisdiction where a claim therefore is being asserted, the interest rate shall be reduced to the applicable maximum legal rate. In addition to this penalty, Supplier will be entitled to obtain from Customer a recovery cost amounting to no more than 40 (forty) Euros.  \nIf Customer, in good faith, disputes any element of the invoiced Fees, Customer may withhold from its payment of the relevant invoice any of these disputed amounts.  Customer may dispute any Fee or other charge by communicating to Supplier in writing Customer’s questions regarding, or objection to, the Fee or charge. \n  Neither the failure to dispute any invoiced amounts prior to payment, nor the failure to withhold any amount, constitutes, operates, or may be construed as a waiver of any right Customer may otherwise have to dispute any amount charged on an invoice, or to recover any amount previously paid. Customer cannot dispute any invoiced Fees after the end of a period of six (6) months following the date of the invoice. "}, {"id": "d0-s24", "doc": 0, "title": "6.3. Hardship", "html": "<p> Parties are required to comply with their obligations, notwithstanding any increase of costs relating to the execution thereof due to an unforeseeable change of circumstances. Parties are fully informed of the specific provisions of article 1195 of the French Civil Code/ article 1664 of the Italian Civil Code and expressly waive any rights they may have under the said article. <\/p><p><strong>6.<\/strong><strong>4<\/strong><strong>. <\/strong><strong>Taxes<\/strong><\/p><p>Transactional Taxes. Unless otherwise provided in this Agreement, the Fees will be exclusive of any applicable transactional taxes, including any sales, use, excise, services, value added tax, goods and services tax, or similar tax, and these taxes should be separately identified by the Supplier in both Supplier’s quote and in the Contract even if the tax rate is zero. The Customer will not be responsible for any transactional taxes charged by the Supplier that are not identified in this manner. The Supplier shall separately state all charges for transactional taxes on its invoices (or other such documents). Additionally, the Supplier shall provide the Customer with invoices in line with the applicable tax laws to enable, when applicable, the Customer to reclaim the transactional taxes and Supplier will provide such documentation no later than when the payment to which the invoice relates is due from the Customer. The Supplier will be responsible, when applicable, for remitting the transactional tax to the applicable taxing authority except for those states or jurisdictions where the Customer has provided the Supplier with an appropriate exemption certificate or when a tax exemption applies to the transaction covered by this Agreement. The Supplier will use reasonable efforts to apply for such exemptions where applicable. The Supplier will not charge the Customer for any transactional taxes charged by a subcontracting supplier if such tax is recoverable by the Service Provider, or if not recoverable, it would have been, had the transaction been structured through other entities (either the Supplier&#x27;s or the Customer&#x27;s Affiliates).  <\/p><p>If transactional taxes are not recoverable by the Supplier, the Supplier agrees to provide detailed billing, customs or other documents as requested, which set out the transactional taxes paid or payable to any of the Customer&#x27;s subcontracting supplier or to a taxing authority.<\/p><p>Witholding Taxes. If under any applicable law in force at the date of payment of any invoice issued by the Supplier, the Customer is required to make any deduction or withholding of taxes or duties from any amount payable to the Supplier in execution of the Agreement, then the amount of the invoice shall be paid after reduction of withholding payment by the Customer  of these taxes provided they are withheld in conformity with the provisions of the international double tax treaty in force between the residence country of the Supplier and the residence country of the Customer (or similar agreement) at the date of the payment and provided they are effectively paid. <\/p><p>Should the applicable International Double Tax Treaty (or similar agreement) provide for a reduced rate or an exemption of withholding tax, the Supplier will provide, before any payment, the Customer with the relevant documentation to allow for qualification for any reduced withholding tax or exemption. <\/p><p>In the case of withholding or payment of taxes, the Customer shall promptly provide the Supplier with any copy of the official documents, evidence of payment, receipts and /or other documentation issued by the relevant authorities, and file all required forms, returns and reports. <\/p><p>In the event that tax legislation is amended, the rates and types of tax shall apply in accordance with such amendments.<\/p><p>Taxes related to the staff deployment. The Supplier, as the case may be,  shall be solely responsible for taxes such as, but not limited to, payroll taxes or personal income taxes related to the employment of staff deployed to provide services to the Customer under this Agreement.<\/p><p>In the event that tax legislation is amended, the rates and types of tax shall apply in accordance with such amendments.<\/p>", "text": " Parties are required to comply with their obligations, notwithstanding any increase of costs relating to the execution thereof due to an unforeseeable change of circumstances. The Supplier will be responsible, when applicable, for remitting the transactional tax to the applicable taxing authority except for those states or jurisdictions where the Customer has provided the Supplier with an appropriate exemption certificate or when a tax exemption applies to the transaction covered by this Agreement. The Supplier, as the case may be,  shall be solely responsible for taxes such as, but not limited to, payroll taxes or personal income taxes related to the employment of staff deployed to provide services to the Customer under this Agreement.\nIn the event that tax legislation is amended, the rates and types of tax shall apply in accordance with such amendments."}, {"id": "d0-s25", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 7 – INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY", "html": "<p><strong>7.1 Background<\/strong><strong> <\/strong> <\/p><p>The Supplier represents that it owns or holds all the Intellectual Property Rights in respect of its Background, used for executing the Services and/or incorporated into (i) the Deliverables, (ii) the Documentation and/or (iii) into the Foreground and, generally speaking, all the rights enabling it to enter into and perform the Agreement.  <\/p><p>Each of the Parties retains the ownership in full of its own Background.  <\/p><p>Should the use of Background be necessary to give full effect to the provisions of Article 7.3 below, including and in particular for the purpose of using the Deliverables and exploiting the Foreground, the Supplier undertakes to grant to Customer a non-exclusive, transferable license for all Intellectual Property Rights with respect to the said Background, with the right to sublicense, for all countries and for the entire duration of the Intellectual Property Rights, as determined in accordance with applicable laws and in accordance with any current or future international conventions. The price of the above Background licence is included in the Fees payable for the Services.  <\/p><p><strong>7<\/strong><strong>.2 Assignment of Foreground<\/strong><strong> <\/strong> <\/p><p>By this Agreement, the Supplier hereby assigns to Customer, definitively and irrevocably, the full and exclusive ownership of all the Intellectual Property Rights attached to the Foreground, including the Deliverables, in any version, whether completed or incomplete, as they are achieved and as soon as they arise, including in particular the rights of exploitation, of reproduction, of representation, of marketing, of distribution, of making available, of extraction, of assignment, the right to license, the right of use, of re-use, of modification, of correction, of translation and of adaptation, as well as all the associated legal and practical warranties, in the broadest manner possible, for the purpose of direct and/or indirect exploitation by Customer, its Affiliates and/or Authorized Third Parties, and in any place or country.  <\/p><p>The Supplier shall provide to the Customer on a periodic basis as defined in the Technical Appendix full copies of Documentation in the respect of the Foreground.  <\/p><p>Assignment under the present article is granted worldwide and for the entire duration of the Intellectual Property Rights, as determined in accordance with applicable laws and in accordance with any current or future international conventions.  <\/p><p>Upon completion of the assignment, Supplier shall no longer have any rights in the Foreground and Deliverables assigned and shall then no longer exploit and/or market such Foreground and Deliverables, directly or indirectly, in any form, whether for consideration or not.   <\/p><p>The price for the assignment of the rights referred to above is included in the Fees payable for the Services.  <\/p><p>It is hereby agreed by the Parties that the Intellectual Property Rights thus assigned include in particular but without limitation:  <\/p><p>in case the Foreground and/or Deliverables are protectable under author rights:  <\/p><p>the right of reproduction, that is to say the right to reproduce or have reproduced all or part of the said Foreground and/or Deliverables, in any medium, in particular paper, magnetic, digital, or using any other electronic means, know or unknown to date, current or future, and without setting limits to the number thereof;  <\/p><p>the right of representation, that is to say the right to represent all or part of the Foreground and/or Deliverables, and in particular the right to display, to exhibit, download, execute, transfer, store, in any manner, using any means, whatever their nature, known or unknown to date, and in particular all the telecommunications networks, current or future, and in any medium, whatever its nature, known or unknown to date, in any form, directly or using the services of a third party or organization;  <\/p><p>the right of distribution, that is to say the right to place on the market, directly or indirectly, whether for consideration or not, including by renting out or lending the said Foreground and/or Deliverables, in part or in whole, using any means and in any medium, known or unknown to date, and whatever its place of destination;  <\/p><p>the right of use, that is to say the right to use, utilise, execute, directly or indirectly, whether for consideration or not, the said Foreground and Deliverables, whatever their place of destination;  <\/p><p>the right of exploitation, that is to say the right to use directly or indirectly, including the right to reassign, transfer, make available to third parties, in part or in whole, whatever the form, and in particular by means of assignment, licence, or any other type of agreement, in any form, all or part of the rights assigned, on a temporary or definitive basis;  <\/p><p>the right of adaptation, that is to say the right to adapt, or to have adapted all or part of the said Foreground and Deliverables, the right to amend them, to allow for their evolution, to design new versions or new developments, to maintain, decompile, mix, modify, assemble, convert, arrange, digitalise, configure, to interface them with any software, database, product, to transcribe said Foreground and Deliverables in part or in whole, in any form, whether or not modified, shortened, condensed, extended, to incorporate all or part thereof towards or into works existing or to come, in any medium whatever their nature, known or unknown to date;  <\/p><p>the right of translation, that is to say the right to translate the Foreground and Deliverables, in part or in whole, into any language, or into any programming language;  <\/p><p>in case the Foreground and/or Deliverables are protectable under patent law:  <\/p><p>the right to file or have filed, in its name, any application for patents or any patents in respect of all or part of the Foreground and/or Deliverables;  <\/p><p>the rights of full and exclusive ownership, of the patent applications and patents in respect of all or part of any Foreground and/or Deliverables which may have been filed;  <\/p><p>in case the Foreground and/or Deliverables are protectable under the <em>sui generis<\/em> right of the database producer:  <\/p><p>the right of extraction, by means of a permanent or temporary transfer of the whole or part of a quantitively or qualitatively substantial part of the contents of the Foreground and/or Deliverables onto any other medium, by any means and in any form, known or unknown to date;  <\/p><p>the right to re-use, by making available to the public the whole or part of a quantitively or qualitatively substantial part of the contents of the Foreground and/or Deliverables, in any form, known or unknown to date.  <\/p><p>Where necessary, the Supplier will assist Customer in (i) formalising and executing any public or private documents (including any reiterative documents), (ii) carrying out any formalities which may be required, for the purpose of assigning the rights as stipulated in this article or of ensuring their full performance. The Supplier acknowledges that such commitment shall be extended beyond the date of expiry or of termination of the Agreement, whatever the reason.  <\/p><p><strong>7<\/strong><strong>. 3. Source Code<\/strong> <\/p><p>At no additional cost to Customer, Supplier undertakes to provide or to deposit its most up-to-date source code of the relevant software forming part of the Background with its authorized escrow agent and shall provide a copy of the signed escrow agreement within five (5) days of the date of execution of this Agreement.  <\/p><p>The Supplier agrees to provide a copy of the most up-to-date source code of the relevant software forming part of the Background and Foreground on a request of the Customer for the sole purpose of supporting and maintaining the Software in the circumstances below:   <\/p><p>Supplier ceases to market or make available maintenance or support services for the Software, <\/p><p>The Agreement is terminated for Supplier’s breach of its obligations <\/p><p>Supplier becomes insolvent,  <\/p><p>Supplier ceases business operation generally or has transferred all or substantially all of its assets or obligations set forth in this Agreement to a third party which doesn’t assume all of the Supplier’s obligations or which is a competitor of the Customer and/or of its Affiliates.  <\/p><p><strong>7<\/strong><strong>.4. Warranties linked to Intellectual Property Rights<\/strong><strong> <\/strong> <\/p><p>7.4.1 Open Source Software <\/p><p>The Supplier undertakes not to include in the Foreground and/or Deliverables any Open Source Software and/or any software owned by third parties, without Customer’s prior express agreement. Should any Open Source Software be included, the Supplier undertakes to comply with the provisions of Appendix IV “FOSS Terms of Use (Free and Open Source Software)”.  <\/p><p>7.4.2 Infringement <\/p><p>Supplier warrants to Customer that the Intellectual Property Rights licensed and/or assigned under this article are not subject to any liens, claims, encumbrances, or to any other restriction.  <\/p><p>Consequently, Supplier shall indemnify, defend and hold Customer, Affiliates, Authorized Third Parties and their respective successors, officers, directors, employees, and agents harmless from and against any and all actions, claims, losses, damages, liabilities, awards, costs, and expenses (including legal fees) initiated by any third party, whoever it may be, who may invoke in particular an Intellectual Property Right or an act of unfair competition practice with respect to the Foreground and/or the Deliverables.   <\/p><p>Therefore, Supplier shall defend and settle, at its expense, all suits or proceedings arising therefrom, provided that (ii) Supplier may not settle or defend any claim unless it unconditionally releases Customer of all liability, (ii) Customer must be kept informed of the progress of the negotiations, and (iii) the negotiations and settlements shall be strictly confidential and not mention publicly Customer or its Affiliates of Authorized Third Parties.  <\/p><p>Customer shall inform Supplier of any such suit or proceeding against Customer and shall have the right to participate in the defence of any such suit or proceeding at its expense and through counsel of its choice.  <\/p><p>Supplier shall inform Customer of any actions, claims, or suits against Supplier based on an alleged infringement of any party&#x27;s Intellectual Property Rights in and to the Foreground and/or the Deliverables promptly or within seven (7) days of becoming aware of the same.  <\/p><p>In the event an injunction is sought or obtained against use of the Deliverable or if Supplier receives information about an infringement or misappropriation claim related to the Foreground and/or the Deliverables, Supplier shall promptly at no cost to Customer:   <\/p><p>modify or replace the Foreground and/or the Deliverables with an equivalent non-infringing element or deliverable within a period deemed by Customer to be compatible with its activity, without hindering the functionalities, performance and quality of the Services and Deliverables, or,  <\/p><p>obtain a licence for Customer’s continued use of the Foreground and/or the Deliverables in accordance with this Agreement.  <\/p><p>Obligations of the present article remain in force for a period equal to the duration of the corresponding Intellectual Property Rights according to this Agreement.   <\/p><p>Supplier shall have no indemnity obligation to Customer, its Affiliates or its Authorized Third Parties under this Article if the claim(s) of infringement is based upon (i) a modification of the Foreground made by Customer, its Affiliates or an Authorized Third Party without Supplier’s prior authorization; or (ii) use of the Foreground in combination with any third-party, software, hardware or service, to the extent that such claim could be asserted but for the combination.  <\/p><p><strong>7.<\/strong><strong>5<\/strong><strong> Other Customer Intellectual Property Rights<\/strong><strong> <\/strong> <\/p><p>Customer can make available to the Supplier any information, any document, any Data or know-how and, generally speaking, any element it may deem necessary to the performance of the Agreement.  <\/p><p>Subject to the confidentiality provisions of this Agreement, Customer retains ownership of any elements communicated to the Supplier for the sole purpose of performing the present Agreement.
