confidential information of the other Party, for any reason whatsoever, except for the performance of the rights and obligations resulting from the present Agreement;  \n(iii) not to disclose the confidential information of the other Party to anyone, by any means, except to their staff, to their legal representatives where applicable or to their subcontractors, should it be strictly necessary that they require such information only for the purpose of executing the Services and subject to their being bound by obligations of confidentiality at least as binding as the obligations herein; \n(iv) to ensure that its staff, its authorized representatives where applicable, its subcontractors and their staff and authorized representatives where applicable, together with any third-party entities or legal persons, are aware of the confidential nature of the information communicated by the other Party, and to accept liability for any disclosure made by the latter;  \n(v) to apply any minimum protective measures it would apply in order to protect its own confidential information. \n(vi) to promptly inform the other Party in case of requests by any police, judicial or administrative authority, in compliance with the laws. \nNon-compliance with such obligations by Supplier may result in the immediate termination of the Agreement, without prejudice to any damages Customer may be entitled to claim.  \nSuch obligations shall remain in force for three (3) years from the date of partial or complete termination of the Agreement, whatever the reason for the termination.  \nThe foregoing provisions shall apply without prejudice to the provisions of Article 7 above."}, {"id": "d0-s29", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 11 – ENTRY INTO FORCE - DURATION", "html": "<p>The Agreement enters into force at the Effective Date. Except in case of early termination in accordance with the terms for termination stipulated herein, the present Agreement shall remain in force until agreed date with Stellantis (“Term”).  <\/p><p>Should a Statement of Work  expire at a later date, the provisions of the Agreement shall remain applicable to the said SOW until its expiry.  <\/p>", "text": "The Agreement enters into force at the Effective Date. Except in case of early termination in accordance with the terms for termination stipulated herein, the present Agreement shall remain in force until agreed date with Stellantis (“Term”).  \nShould a Statement of Work  expire at a later date, the provisions of the Agreement shall remain applicable to the said SOW until its expiry.  "}, {"id": "d0-s30", "doc": 0, "title": "12.1. Termination for cause", "html": "<p><strong>12.1.1<\/strong> In case of breach by one of the Parties with its obligations under the Agreement, the other Party will give notice to the defaulting Party by certified letter and/or certified mails, with acknowledgement of receipt to remedy such breach within (30) days. Should the defaulting Party fail to fully remedy the said breach within the aforementioned thirty (30) day period, the Party which issued the notice shall be entitled to terminate the Agreement, without prejudice to any other rights and remedies that the non-defaulting Party may claim in respect of the said breach.  <\/p><p>If the Party issuing the notice is the Supplier, Supplier may terminate the Agreement with a 90 (ninety) days notice by registered letter (after expiration of the prior 30 (thirty) day remediation period).  <\/p><p>If the Party issuing the notice is the Customer, Customer may terminate the Agreement with a 30 (thirty) days notice by registered letter (after expiration of the prior 30 (thirty) day remediation period). <\/p><p>In case of breach by Supplier of any provisions of Article 18 “Labor Obligations” and Article 21.11 “Code of Conduct – Compliance – Export Control”, Customer shall have the right to immediately terminate the Agreement by sending a registered letter or email to Supplier. In addition, any claims for payment by Supplier may be forfeited.  <\/p><p><strong>12.1.2<\/strong>Should the Supplier be unable to execute the Services in accordance with the SOW concerned (including within the agreed time frame) within 30 (thirty) days of being notified by Customer of the breach of one of its obligations under the Framework Agreement and/or under the SOW concerned, the Supplier shall reimburse, at the leatest within 60 (sixty) days of the date of issuance of the said notification by Customer, any amount already paid to it under the SOW concerned, without prejudice to the provisions referred to in article 12.1.1 above or to any damages that Customer may be entitled to claim in respect of such breach. <\/p><p><strong>12.1.3<\/strong>Furthermore, Customer reserves the right to have the said unperformed Services executed by a third party, including a competitor of the Supplier, and to the exclusive expense of the latter. In such case, the Supplier undertakes not to initiate infringement or unfair competition proceedings against such third party and to provide support to Customer and/or to the third party commissioned by Customer to execute the said Services, upon reasonable request by Customer.<\/p><p><strong>12.1.<\/strong><strong>4<\/strong>The termination shall be for the future only and start on the termination letter or email date as appropriate.<\/p>", "text": "12.1.1 In case of breach by one of the Parties with its obligations under the Agreement, the other Party will give notice to the defaulting Party by certified letter and/or certified mails, with acknowledgement of receipt to remedy such breach within (30) days. Should the defaulting Party fail to fully remedy the said breach within the aforementioned thirty (30) day period, the Party which issued the notice shall be entitled to terminate the Agreement, without prejudice to any other rights and remedies that the non-defaulting Party may claim in respect of the said breach.  \nIf the Party issuing the notice is the Supplier, Supplier may terminate the Agreement with a 90 (ninety) days notice by registered letter (after expiration of the prior 30 (thirty) day remediation period).  \nIf the Party issuing the notice is the Customer, Customer may terminate the Agreement with a 30 (thirty) days notice by registered letter (after expiration of the prior 30 (thirty) day remediation period). \nIn case of breach by Supplier of any provisions of Article 18 “Labor Obligations” and Article 21.11 “Code of Conduct – Compliance – Export Control”, Customer shall have the right to immediately terminate the Agreement by sending a registered letter or email to Supplier. In addition, any claims for payment by Supplier may be forfeited.  \n12.1.2Should the Supplier be unable to execute the Services in accordance with the SOW concerned (including within the agreed time frame) within 30 (thirty) days of being notified by Customer of the breach of one of its obligations under the Framework Agreement and/or under the SOW concerned, the Supplier shall reimburse, at the leatest within 60 (sixty) days of the date of issuance of the said notification by Customer, any amount already paid to it under the SOW concerned, without prejudice to the provisions referred to in article 12.1.1 above or to any damages that Customer may be entitled to claim in respect of such breach. \n12.1.3Furthermore, Customer reserves the right to have the said unperformed Services executed by a third party, including a competitor of the Supplier, and to the exclusive expense of the latter. In such case, the Supplier undertakes not to initiate infringement or unfair competition proceedings against such third party and to provide support to Customer and/or to the third party commissioned by Customer to execute the said Services, upon reasonable request by Customer.\n12.1.4The termination shall be for the future only and start on the termination letter or email date as appropriate."}, {"id": "d0-s31", "doc": 0, "title": "12.2. Termination for convenience", "html": "<p>Customer may, at its option, terminate all or any part of this Agreement before the expiration of the Term, at any time and for any reason, by giving written notice to Supplier in compliance with the applicable laws, according to Article 22. <\/p><p>In the event Customer exercises its right to terminate for convenience under this Section, Customer will pay to Supplier only the following amounts, without duplication: (a) the Fees for all  services that have been ordered through an Order and completed in accordance with this Agreement and not previously paid for until the date of termination; and (b) the duly proved actual costs of work-in-progress and raw materials incurred by Supplier in furnishing the  services under the Order related to this Agreement, to the extent such costs are reasonable in amount and are in accordance with supply chain requirements of Customer, as amended from time to time. <\/p><p>For clarity, all and any other costs in relation to or in connection with this termination are excluded (such as general and administrative burden charges, overhead, facilities, or loss of anticipated profit). <\/p><p>Any request for payment submitted to Customer under this Section must include sufficient supporting data to permit an audit by Customer, including, without limitation, such supplemental and supporting information whether from Supplier or its subcontractors. Any payment under this Section will not be deemed a waiver of any of Customer&#x27;s other rights arising under this Agreement or applicable law. <\/p><p>The payment specified in this Section is Supplier’s sole remedy for termination of this Agreement under this Section. Supplier shall be under a general obligation to mitigate amounts claimed under this Section. Any exclusions or limitations of claims or cost positions shall also apply in case Customer reduces the scope of applications or number of programs in which goods supplied by Supplier will be used for. This shall be without prejudice to any other rights of the Customer.<\/p>", "text": "Customer may, at its option, terminate all or any part of this Agreement before the expiration of the Term, at any time and for any reason, by giving written notice to Supplier in compliance with the applicable laws, according to Article 22. \nIn the event Customer exercises its right to terminate for convenience under this Section, Customer will pay to Supplier only the following amounts, without duplication: (a) the Fees for all  services that have been ordered through an Order and completed in accordance with this Agreement and not previously paid for until the date of termination; and (b) the duly proved actual costs of work-in-progress and raw materials incurred by Supplier in furnishing the  services under the Order related to this Agreement, to the extent such costs are reasonable in amount and are in accordance with supply chain requirements of Customer, as amended from time to time. \nFor clarity, all and any other costs in relation to or in connection with this termination are excluded (such as general and administrative burden charges, overhead, facilities, or loss of anticipated profit). \nAny request for payment submitted to Customer under this Section must include sufficient supporting data to permit an audit by Customer, including, without limitation, such supplemental and supporting information whether from Supplier or its subcontractors. Any payment under this Section will not be deemed a waiver of any of Customer's other rights arising under this Agreement or applicable law. \nThe payment specified in this Section is Supplier’s sole remedy for termination of this Agreement under this Section. Supplier shall be under a general obligation to mitigate amounts claimed under this Section. Any exclusions or limitations of claims or cost positions shall also apply in case Customer reduces the scope of applications or number of programs in which goods supplied by Supplier will be used for. This shall be without prejudice to any other rights of the Customer."}, {"id": "d0-s32", "doc": 0, "title": "12.3 Termination for Change of Control", "html": "<p>In the event of a change in control of Supplier and/or its parent company where such control is acquired, directly or indirectly, in a single transaction or series of related transactions, or all or substantially all of the assets of Supplier or its parent company are acquired by any entity or a group of related or unrelated entities, or Supplier or its parent company is merged with or into another entity to form a new entity, or Supplier sells the Services or otherwise transfers such assets to another entity (each a “Change of Control Event”) then at any time within 90 days after Change of Control Event occurs, Customer may terminate this Agreement, without compensation to Supplier, by giving the Supplier a prior written notice and designating a date upon which such termination shall be effective.<\/p>", "text": "In the event of a change in control of Supplier and/or its parent company where such control is acquired, directly or indirectly, in a single transaction or series of related transactions, or all or substantially all of the assets of Supplier or its parent company are acquired by any entity or a group of related or unrelated entities, or Supplier or its parent company is merged with or into another entity to form a new entity, or Supplier sells the Services or otherwise transfers such assets to another entity (each a “Change of Control Event”) then at any time within 90 days after Change of Control Event occurs, Customer may terminate this Agreement, without compensation to Supplier, by giving the Supplier a prior written notice and designating a date upon which such termination shall be effective."}, {"id": "d0-s33", "doc": 0, "title": "12.4. Refund", "html": "<p>If this Agreement is terminated by Customer in accordance with this Article, Supplier will refund Customer any prepaid fees covering the remainder of the term. In no event will termination relieve Customer of its obligation to pay any fees payable to Supplier for the period prior to the effective date of termination.  <\/p>", "text": "If this Agreement is terminated by Customer in accordance with this Article, Supplier will refund Customer any prepaid fees covering the remainder of the term. In no event will termination relieve Customer of its obligation to pay any fees payable to Supplier for the period prior to the effective date of termination.  "}, {"id": "d0-s34", "doc": 0, "title": "12.5. Consequences of the termination", "html": "<p><strong>12<\/strong><strong>.<\/strong><strong>5<\/strong><strong>.1<\/strong>Upon expiry of the Framework Agreement and/or of each Statement of Work, and for any reason, Customer may choose to return or destroy the Deliverables not paid for at the date of termination or to keep all or part of the said Deliverables and make the corresponding payment in accordance with the financial terms set out in each Financial Appendix. All such elements shall become the material and intellectual property of Customer without the need to reiterate the registration thereof, and under the terms of the Article- 7 “Intellectual Property” above. <\/p><p><strong>1<\/strong><strong>2.<\/strong><strong>5<\/strong><strong>.2<\/strong><strong><\/strong>The termination of the Framework Agreement for any reason shall not cause the termination of the Statement of Work still in force on the date of such termination. In case of termination of the Framework Agreement, the provisions thereof shall remain applicable to the said Statement of Work.<\/p><p><strong>12.<\/strong><strong>5<\/strong><strong>.3<\/strong><strong><\/strong>Subject to the provisions of Article 11 above, the termination of a Statement of Work shall cause neither the termination of the Framework Agreement, nor that of the other Statement(s) of Work.<\/p><p><strong>12.<\/strong><strong>5<\/strong><strong>.4<\/strong>The terms for termination set out in the present Article 12 are without prejudice to any other terms for termination expressly set out in the present Framework Agreement and/or in any applicable Statement of Work, which they complement. <\/p>", "text": "12.5.1Upon expiry of the Framework Agreement and/or of each Statement of Work, and for any reason, Customer may choose to return or destroy the Deliverables not paid for at the date of termination or to keep all or part of the said Deliverables and make the corresponding payment in accordance with the financial terms set out in each Financial Appendix. All such elements shall become the material and intellectual property of Customer without the need to reiterate the registration thereof, and under the terms of the Article- 7 “Intellectual Property” above. \n12.5.2The termination of the Framework Agreement for any reason shall not cause the termination of the Statement of Work still in force on the date of such termination. In case of termination of the Framework Agreement, the provisions thereof shall remain applicable to the said Statement of Work.\n12.5.3Subject to the provisions of Article 11 above, the termination of a Statement of Work shall cause neither the termination of the Framework Agreement, nor that of the other Statement(s) of Work.\n12.5.4The terms for termination set out in the present Article 12 are without prejudice to any other terms for termination expressly set out in the present Framework Agreement and/or in any applicable Statement of Work, which they complement. "}, {"id": "d0-s35", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 13 – REVERSIBILITY - TERMINATION ASSISTANCE SERVICES", "html": "<p>In the event of a partial and/or entire termination of the Agreement for whatever reason, Supplier shall promptly provide assistance as follows: where the Customer chooses to migrate to a different service and/or different provider of services, Customer may request that Supplier provides assistance in such transition through Supplier’s professional services organization (e.g. by implementing and/or  by making available a sufficiently large team, composed of experienced individuals to execute in the best conditions, both in terms of deadline and in terms of quality or integrity of Data, all operations ensuring the aforesaid reversibility, in order to enable Customer, or any third party appointed by it, to recover or to entrust to any third party the recovery of the Services entirely or partially) at reasonable and duly proved costs to be agreed upon in writing by the Parties (“Termination Assistance Services”).<\/p><p>At a minimum, Termination Assistance Services must include all the information and assistance that Customer requires to ensure a complete and accurate transition of the performance of all Services provided by Supplier under this Agreement to either a third-party vendor or to Customer at any location.  Any additional or specific services described in the applicable SOW as “Termination Assistance Services” are also within the scope of Termination Assistance Services required under this Agreement.<\/p><p>Except as otherwise requested by Customer, during the first thirty (30) days after any notice of termination of this Agreement, Supplier will assist Customer in the creation of a termination assistance plan setting forth the project plan and schedule for completion of the Termination Assistance Services, including, but not limited to, the portions of the Services that will be provided by Supplier during the Termination Transition Period (the “TA Plan”).  Customer reserves the right to modify the requirements for the TA Plan upon reasonable notice to Supplier and provided the modification does not imply additional significant costs for Supplier. <\/p><p>To the extent Customer requests Termination Assistance Services or other Services during the Termination Transition Period, (i) such Termination Assistance Services will be provided subject to and in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement, (ii) Supplier will perform the Services with at least the same degree of accuracy, quality, completeness, timeliness, responsiveness and resource efficiency as it provided and was required to provide the same or similar services during the Term, (iii) the quality and level of performance of the Services provided by Supplier following the expiration or termination of the Term or Supplier’s receipt of a notice of termination or non-renewal must continue to meet or exceed any Service Levels specified in the applicable SOW, and must not be degraded or deficient in any, and (iv) any individuals identified in the applicable SOW as “key Supplier personnel” must be retained on the Customer account through the completion of all relevant Termination Assistance Services. <\/p><p>If Supplier fails to perform its obligations under this Article 13, Customer may acquire the services of third parties to perform the Termination Assistance Services, and Supplier must pay Customer’s costs for those services. The foregoing provision is subject to: a) Customer providing Supplier with a written notice giving Supplier ten (10) working days to cure the failure; (b) Supplier non-curing of such failure; (c) services acquired by Customer being of equivalent nature and scope as of the Termination Assistance Services; (d) costs proposed by third party provider being reasonable and duly evidenced.<\/p><p>Charges for Termination Assistance Services from the effective date of termination until the expiration of the Termination Transition Period will be calculated as described in the Financial Appendix Attachment attached to the relevant SOW. If none, the parties will negotiate in good faith the charges applicable during the Termination Transition Period.<\/p><p>Furthermore, Supplier shall, at Customer’s request: <\/p><p>at no additional cost return all Data in its possession in the most technically appropriate form and in standard format and/or; <\/p><p>at no additional cost, proceed with the destruction of any potential stored or recorded Data by Supplier; It is understood that Supplier shall not keep any copy nor use the Data, whatever the reason, except when the storage is required by any current applicable laws and/or regulations. <\/p>", "text": "In the event of a partial and/or entire termination of the Agreement for whatever reason, Supplier shall promptly provide assistance as follows: where the Customer chooses to migrate to a different service and/or different provider of services, Customer may request that Supplier provides assistance in such transition through Supplier’s professional services organization (e.g. by implementing and/or  by making available a sufficiently large team, composed of experienced individuals to execute in the best conditions, both in terms of deadline and in terms of quality or integrity of Data, all operations ensuring the aforesaid reversibility, in order to enable Customer, or any third party appointed by it, to recover or to entrust to any third party the recovery of the Services entirely or partially) at reasonable and duly proved costs to be agreed upon in writing by the Parties (“Termination Assistance Services”).\nAt a minimum, Termination Assistance Services must include all the information and assistance that Customer requires to ensure a complete and accurate transition of the performance of all Services provided by Supplier under this Agreement to either a third-party vendor or to Customer at any location.  Any additional or specific services described in the applicable SOW as “Termination Assistance Services” are also within the scope of Termination Assistance Services required under this Agreement.\nExcept as otherwise requested by Customer, during the first thirty (30) days after any notice of termination of this Agreement, Supplier will assist Customer in the creation of a termination assistance plan setting forth the project plan and schedule for completion of the Termination Assistance Services, including, but not limited to, the portions of the Services that will be provided by Supplier during the Termination Transition Period (the “TA Plan”).  Customer reserves the right to modify the requirements for the TA Plan upon reasonable notice to Supplier and provided the modification does not imply additional significant costs for Supplier. \nTo the extent Customer requests Termination Assistance Services or other Services during the Termination Transition Period, (i) such Termination Assistance Services will be provided subject to and in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement, (ii) Supplier will perform the Services with at least the same degree of accuracy, quality, completeness, timeliness, responsiveness and resource efficiency as it provided and was required to provide the same or similar services during the Term, (iii) the quality and level of performance of the Services provided by Supplier following the expiration or termination of the Term or Supplier’s receipt of a notice of termination or non-renewal must continue to meet or exceed any Service Levels specified in the applicable SOW, and must not be degraded or deficient in any, and (iv) any individuals identified in the applicable SOW as “key Supplier personnel” must be retained on the Customer account through the completion of all relevant Termination Assistance Services. \nIf Supplier fails to perform its obligations under this Article 13, Customer may acquire the services of third parties to perform the Termination Assistance Services, and Supplier must pay Customer’s costs for those services. The foregoing provision is subject to: a) Customer providing Supplier with a written notice giving Supplier ten (10) working days to cure the failure; (b) Supplier non-curing of such failure; (c) services acquired by Customer being of equivalent nature and scope as of the Termination Assistance Services; (d) costs proposed by third party provider being reasonable and duly evidenced.\nCharges for Termination Assistance Services from the effective date of termination until the expiration of the Termination Transition Period will be calculated as described in the Financial Appendix Attachment attached to the relevant SOW. If none, the parties will negotiate in good faith the charges applicable during the Termination Transition Period.\nFurthermore, Supplier shall, at Customer’s request: \nat no additional cost return all Data in its possession in the most technically appropriate form and in standard format and/or; \nat no additional cost, proceed with the destruction of any potential stored or recorded Data by Supplier; It is understood that Supplier shall not keep any copy nor use the Data, whatever the reason, except when the storage is required by any current applicable laws and/or regulations. "}, {"id": "d0-s36", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 14 – INSURANCE", "html": "<p>Supplier shall, at its own expense, obtain and continuously maintain an adequate insurance contract with a primary insurance company covering against financial consequences of its civil liability (should it be incurred) in respect of Customer, its Affiliates and any third parties. Such insurance contract must include – without limitation – product liability coverage. The Supplier shall also maintain adequate Cybersecurity insurance coverage <\/p><p>In case a risk of product liability and/or recall campaign is connected to Supplier’s provisioning of the Services, the latter shall, at its own expense, obtain and continuously maintain an adequate insurance contract covering Suppliers’ obligations on product liability and recall campaign with a primary insurance company which adequately covers Supplier’s liability towards Customer, its Affiliates and any third parties.   <\/p><p>Supplier shall provide Customer, on yearly basis, with evidence of the existence and the extent of coverage of such insurance and the insurance premium payment receipts. <\/p><p>The existence of any insurance will not release Supplier of any of its obligations or liabilities under this Agreement and/or the applicable law. <\/p><p>Supplier shall be required to inform Customer of the termination of any insurance contracts above providing with the evidence of the new agreement arranged with a new insurance company replacing the previous one. <\/p><p>Supplier undertakes to submit on the date of execution of the present Agreement on the Stellantis B2B portal and to supply to Customer a certificate indicating the amounts of the guarantees underwritten and the proof of payments made.  <\/p>", "text": "Supplier shall, at its own expense, obtain and continuously maintain an adequate insurance contract with a primary insurance company covering against financial consequences of its civil liability (should it be incurred) in respect of Customer, its Affiliates and any third parties. Such insurance contract must include – without limitation – product liability coverage. The Supplier shall also maintain adequate Cybersecurity insurance coverage \nIn case a risk of product liability and/or recall campaign is connected to Supplier’s provisioning of the Services, the latter shall, at its own expense, obtain and continuously maintain an adequate insurance contract covering Suppliers’ obligations on product liability and recall campaign with a primary insurance company which adequately covers Supplier’s liability towards Customer, its Affiliates and any third parties.   \nSupplier shall provide Customer, on yearly basis, with evidence of the existence and the extent of coverage of such insurance and the insurance premium payment receipts. \nThe existence of any insurance will not release Supplier of any of its obligations or liabilities under this Agreement and/or the applicable law. \nSupplier shall be required to inform Customer of the termination of any insurance contracts above providing with the evidence of the new agreement arranged with a new insurance company replacing the previous one. \nSupplier undertakes to submit on the date of execution of the present Agreement on the Stellantis B2B portal and to supply to Customer a certificate indicating the amounts of the guarantees underwritten and the proof of payments made.  "}, {"id": "d0-s37", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 15 - FORCE MAJEURE", "html": "<p>Any delay or failure of either Party to perform its obligations under the Agreement will be excused to the extent such performance is prevented, restricted, or interfered directly as the result of a Force Majeure Event, and provided that a written notice of such Force Majeure Event (including the anticipated duration of the delay) is given by the affected Party to the other Party as soon as possible (but in no event more than 5 (five) days after the force majeure event occurs). The affected Party will use all diligent efforts to minimize the effects of any Force Majeure Event and, as promptly as possible, resume full performance under the Agreement. The period of suspension of the Agreement shall not exceed thirty (30) calendar days. Upon expiry of such period, either Party may terminate the Agreement as of right by registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt together with a certified letter.    <\/p>", "text": "Any delay or failure of either Party to perform its obligations under the Agreement will be excused to the extent such performance is prevented, restricted, or interfered directly as the result of a Force Majeure Event, and provided that a written notice of such Force Majeure Event (including the anticipated duration of the delay) is given by the affected Party to the other Party as soon as possible (but in no event more than 5 (five) days after the force majeure event occurs). The affected Party will use all diligent efforts to minimize the effects of any Force Majeure Event and, as promptly as possible, resume full performance under the Agreement. The period of suspension of the Agreement shall not exceed thirty (30) calendar days. Upon expiry of such period, either Party may terminate the Agreement as of right by registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt together with a certified letter.    "}, {"id": "d0-s38", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 16 - SUBCONTRACTING", "html": "<p>Supplier may subcontract a part of its obligation, upon the written consent and approval by Customer, being specified that Customer may refuse to approve any subcontractor without justifying its decision.  <\/p><p>For the sake of clarity, any change of subcontractor shall be submitted to specific request under the conditions of the present provision.  <\/p><p>In this context, Supplier undertakes to hire only subcontractors that provide sufficient safeguards and warranty, equivalent to those of Supplier, in particular when they intervene for the sake of the implementation of all technical and organizational measures appropriate to processing of Data and, more specifically, Personal Data made in application of the Agreement. Supplier shall provide to Customer before any requests of subcontracting with all evidence enabling to make sure that such subcontractor provides sufficient safeguards, equivalent to those required from Supplier in application of the Agreement.  <\/p><p>Consequently, Supplier remains fully liable to Customer for the execution of all and/or any parts of the Services by any of its subcontractors, notably in case of any breach of the instructions given in relation to Personal Data processing which it implements on behalf of Customer. <\/p><p>Furthermore, Supplier undertakes to make sure that its subcontractors comply with the provisions set forth under Article 21.11-Code of Conduct-Compliance-Export Control of this Agreement.<\/p>", "text": "Supplier may subcontract a part of its obligation, upon the written consent and approval by Customer, being specified that Customer may refuse to approve any subcontractor without justifying its decision.  \nFor the sake of clarity, any change of subcontractor shall be submitted to specific request under the conditions of the present provision.  \nIn this context, Supplier undertakes to hire only subcontractors that provide sufficient safeguards and warranty, equivalent to those of Supplier, in particular when they intervene for the sake of the implementation of all technical and organizational measures appropriate to processing of Data and, more specifically, Personal Data made in application of the Agreement. Supplier shall provide to Customer before any requests of subcontracting with all evidence enabling to make sure that such subcontractor provides sufficient safeguards, equivalent to those required from Supplier in application of the Agreement.  \nConsequently, Supplier remains fully liable to Customer for the execution of all and/or any parts of the Services by any of its subcontractors, notably in case of any breach of the instructions given in relation to Personal Data processing which it implements on behalf of Customer. \nFurthermore, Supplier undertakes to make sure that its subcontractors comply with the provisions set forth under Article 21.11-Code of Conduct-Compliance-Export Control of this Agreement."}, {"id": "d0-s39", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 17 – ASSIGNMENT", "html": "<p>The Framework Agreement and each Service request form are executed for the purpose of entering into a business relation with Supplier<em>.<\/em> Consequently, the Supplier shall not transfer, assign or convey all or part of its rights and obligations under the present Framework Agreement and/or a Statement of work, in any form and for any reason, or assume all or part of the rights and obligations of a third party, without prior written agreement by Customer.<\/p><p>Customer may, at its own discretion, transfer, assign or convey all or part of its obligations under the Agreement to one of its Affiliates, in any form and for any reason, and such company may then assume all or part of the rights and obligations of Customer, without prior written agreement by Supplier.    <\/p><p>Customer may, at its own discretion, transfer, assign or convey all or part of its obligations under the Agreement to a third party, in any form and for any reason, and such company may then assume all or part of the rights and obligations of Customer, with prior written agreement by Supplier, that should not unreasonably be denied.<\/p>", "text": "The Framework Agreement and each Service request form are executed for the purpose of entering into a business relation with Supplier. Consequently, the Supplier shall not transfer, assign or convey all or part of its rights and obligations under the present Framework Agreement and/or a Statement of work, in any form and for any reason, or assume all or part of the rights and obligations of a third party, without prior written agreement by Customer.\nCustomer may, at its own discretion, transfer, assign or convey all or part of its obligations under the Agreement to one of its Affiliates, in any form and for any reason, and such company may then assume all or part of the rights and obligations of Customer, without prior written agreement by Supplier.    \nCustomer may, at its own discretion, transfer, assign or convey all or part of its obligations under the Agreement to a third party, in any form and for any reason, and such company may then assume all or part of the rights and obligations of Customer, with prior written agreement by Supplier, that should not unreasonably be denied."}, {"id": "d0-s40", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 18 – LABOR OBLIGATIONS", "html": "<p><strong>18.1.<\/strong>The Supplier undertakes to comply and ensure compliance by his staff with the legal and regulatory provisions applicable in labour law, even whether they are the result of directives or national transposition measures, as well as with all the health and security rules in force on the place(s) of execution of the Services. <\/p><p>The Supplier carries out the management of administrative, tax, social security and accounting tasks with respect to the staff assigned to the execution of the Services. In this regard, the staff of the Supplier remains at all times under the sole responsibility and authority of Supplier and shall under no circumstances be deemed to be employees of Customer. Such staff receives no direct orders from Customer staff and the Supplier alone is authorized to give work instructions, monitor, assess the individual performance of and, where applicable, apply sanctions against the employees assigned to the execution of the Services. <\/p><p>The Supplier shall act in compliance with social security legislation ensuring that any contracts under which members of its staff are employed at any of the places of business of Customer are in compliance with applicable employment laws – even whether derived from directives or transposition measures. In this respect Supplier must submit, at the latest on the date of execution of the Agreement, all the certificates or any other documents required under the legislation in force, applicable to its activities at the place of performance of the tasks assigned to it. <\/p><p>The Supplier undertakes to ensure compliance by its subcontractors and by any temporary employment agencies, to whom it may entrust the performance of operations consistent with the purpose of the Agreement, with the legislative and regulatory provisions referred to in the present article, and to obtain from the said subcontractors and agencies any certificates and other documents required under the applicable legislation.  <\/p><p>The legality of the situation of the staff of the Supplier is a material condition for the performance of the tasks assigned to Supplier. Therefore, any proven breach of the laws or regulations referred to above, of which Customer were informed, may result in the immediate termination of the Agreement, without prior notice or compensation. The termination shall be effective from the date of its notification by certified letter with acknowledgement of receipt. In case of third-party claims or legal proceedings against Customer due to the non-compliance by Supplier and/or its subcontractors with the legislative and regulatory provisions in force, the Supplier shall hold Customer harmless against any expenses, fines and damages which Customer may be sentenced to pay.  <\/p><p><strong>18.2.<\/strong>Without prejudice to the provisions referred to above in Article 18.1, and in compliance with the actions undertaken to combat concealed employment, pursuant to European and national law, the Supplier shall submit to Customer all the certificates and other documents required under the applicable legislation, according to the periodicity foreseen by the legislation.  <\/p><p>In application of the preceding paragraph, if the service is provided in France, the Supplier shall: <\/p><p>comply with article L. 8222-1 and subsequent articles, L.8254-1 and subsequent articles and D.8254-2 of the French Labour Code; <\/p><p>submit to Customer all documents referred to in articles L.1221-10, L. 3243-2, R. 3243-1 and D. 8222-5, according to the periodicity foreseen in the French Labour Code. <\/p><p>Regarding foreign suppliers and subcontractors, a certificate of similar nature as the certificate required from French companies is required.  <\/p><p>Additionally, Supplier shall submit: <\/p><p>in case of secondment: either an A1 certificate (regulation (EU) n° 883/20044) or the certificate provided for in the bilateral agreement regarding Social Security, <\/p><p>in other cases, a certificate of deposit of social security statements and of payment with respect to any applicable Social Security contributions. <\/p><p>The documents must be submitted in the official language of the Country in which the Service is provided or accompanied by a certified translation into this language. <\/p><p>While executing this agreement, Supplier shall comply with laws and regulations on health and safety applicable in the Country in which the Service is provided.<\/p>", "text": "18.1.The Supplier undertakes to comply and ensure compliance by his staff with the legal and regulatory provisions applicable in labour law, even whether executing this agreement, Supplier shall comply with laws and regulations on health and safety applicable in the Country in which the Service is provided."}, {"id": "d0-s41", "doc": 0, "title": "19.1.  Data", "html": "<p>The Parties commonly agree that Data operated, processed, hosted, backed-up or even stored by the Supplier on behalf of Customer or at Customer’s initiative are and remain the ownership or rightful use of Customer. Any use by Supplier of Data for its own purpose or needs, even in an aggregated or anonymized form, is expressly prohibited. For the avoidance of doubt, the provision of any Data by Stellantis to Supplier for Suppliers’ own purposes or needs shall subject to a separately negotiated agreement between the Parties.<\/p><p>Customer retains the entire control on its data bases.  <\/p>", "text": "The Parties commonly agree that Data operated, processed, hosted, backed-up or even stored by the Supplier on behalf of Customer or at Customer’s initiative are and remain the ownership or rightful use of Customer. Any use by Supplier of Data for its own purpose or needs, even in an aggregated or anonymized form, is expressly prohibited. For the avoidance of doubt, the provision of any Data by Stellantis to Supplier for Suppliers’ own purposes or needs shall subject to a separately negotiated agreement between the Parties.\nCustomer retains the entire control on its data bases.  "}, {"id": "d0-s42", "doc": 0, "title": "19.2.  Security", "html": "<p>The Supplier will provide Customer on an annual basis with a copy of any external certifications which are less than two years old at that point such as SSAE 18, including in particular the SOC 2, Type II, ISO 27001 and ISO 27018 reports detailing Supplier’s compliance with industry information security standards or any cybersecurity maturity assessment that may be provided by a legitimized third party (such as the National Institute of Standards and Technology) .For the avoidance of doubt such certifications must have been issued within the two years prior to their provision to the Customer pursuant to this Article.  <\/p><p>The Supplier undertakes to take the best possible technical means, by using the most updated technology, enabling to ensure the integrity, reliability, security, availability and the constant resilience of the processing systems and services, confidentiality and the Customer Data traceability, as well as to ensure secured access to Customer Technical Environment.    <\/p><p>In this context, and due to its quality of recognized professional, the Supplier undertakes to assist and to provide Customer with all useful advice, in order to prevent Customer Date or Technical Environment from being used in a fraudulent manner, their integrity being endangered or that their access being made impossible. To do so, the Supplier undertakes in particular:  <\/p><p>to ensure full confidentiality of Data;  <\/p><p>to report immediately any security incident or cyberattack to the Supplier to the following address soc@stellantis.com. The Supplier must include in this report any indicators of compromise.  <\/p><p>to issue, within no more than seventy-two (72) hours from any acknowledgment of any risk or any security incident which might affect the integrity, the reliability, the security, the availability and the constant resilience of the processing systems and services, the confidentiality and the traceability of Data and information system of the Customer, a report:  <\/p><p>detailing the nature of the identified risk or incident and its level, because of its gravity, in particular by virtue of its potential prejudice and its degree of probability, with regard to state of art, implementation costs, nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing;   <\/p><p>by suggesting all technical and organizational measures as well as a periodicity of re-examination which it considers useful to set in its quality of recognized professional, to remedy it, so as to guarantee a level of security relevant and proportional to the identified risk in terms of means to be used and of process to be implemented, in particular to restore the availability of Data and access to these in a appropriate deadline in case of physical or technical incident;  <\/p><p>to guarantee the physical and material security of its premises whatever their location (on prem or on the cloud), in order to prevent any destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure of Data, unauthorized access to Customer information system, by in particular using:   <\/p><p>an authentication system, in particular, by access badges, of duly authorized persons (among which its employees or, if any, processors or any other service provider, including its own advisors);  <\/p><p>a Closed Circuit TV (CCTV) system implemented and operated in compliance with the requirements of European Regulation and any other relevant legislations;   <\/p><p>measures likely to slow down any possible intrusion or any fire risk, thanks to the installation of <\/p><p> alarms duly planned for that purpose;  <\/p><p>to notify, as soon as possible, to Customer any security breach (such as access by unauthorized persons to the Customer Technical Environment, alteration, destruction, loss, modification, infringement of integrity of Data or their disclosure) with the nature of the breach and the measures taken or to be taken to remedy to such breach.  <\/p>", "text": "The Supplier will provide Customer on an annual basis with a copy of any external certifications which are less than two years old at that point such as SSAE 18, may be provided by a legitimized third party (such as the National Institute of Standards and Technology) .For the avoidance of doubt such certifications must have been issued within the two years integrity, reliability, security, availability and the constant resilience of the processing systems and services, confidentiality and the Customer Data traceability, as well as to ensure secured access to Customer Technical Environment.    \nIn this context, and due to its quality of recognized professional, the Supplier undertakes to assist and to provide Customer with all useful advice, in order to prevent Customer Date or Technical Environment from being used in a fraudulent manner, their integrity being endangered or that their access being made impossible. To do so, the Supplier undertakes in particular:  \nto ensure full confidentiality of Data;  \nto report immediately any security incident or cyberattack to the Supplier to the following address soc@stellantis.com. The Supplier must include in this report any indicators of compromise.  \nto issue, within no more than seventy-two (72) hours from any acknowledgment of any risk or any security incident which might affect the integrity, the reliability, the security, the availability and the constant resilience of the processing systems and services, the confidentiality and the traceability of Data and information system of the Customer, a report:  \ndetailing the nature of the identified risk or incident and its level, because of its gravity, in particular by virtue of its potential prejudice and its degree of probability, with regard to state of art, implementation costs, nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing;   \nby suggesting all technical and organizational measures as well as a periodicity of re-examination which it considers useful to set in its quality of recognized professional, to remedy it, so as to guarantee a level of security relevant and proportional to the identified risk in terms of means to be used and of process to be implemented, in particular to restore the availability of Data and access to these in a appropriate deadline in case of physical or technical incident;  \nto guarantee the physical and material security of its premises whatever their location (on prem or on the cloud), in order to prevent any destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure of Data, unauthorized access to Customer information system, by in particular using:   \nan authentication system, in particular, by access badges, of duly authorized persons (among which its employees or, if any, processors or any other service provider, including its own advisors);  \na Closed Circuit TV (CCTV) system implemented and operated in compliance with the requirements of European Regulation and any other relevant legislations;   \nmeasures likely to slow down any possible intrusion or any fire risk, thanks to the installation of \n alarms duly planned for that purpose;  \nto notify, as soon as possible, to Customer any security breach (such as access by unauthorized persons to the Customer Technical Environment, alteration, destruction, loss, modification, infringement of integrity of Data or their disclosure) with the nature of the breach and the measures taken or to be taken to remedy to such breach.  "}, {"id": "d0-s43", "doc": 0, "title": "19.3.  Protection  of Personal Data", "html": "<p>The criteria will be provided on the specific document joined to the RFQ.<\/p>", "text": "The criteria will be provided on the specific document joined to the RFQ."}, {"id": "d0-s44", "doc": 0, "title": "ARTICLE 20 – AUDIT", "html": "<p>20.1 During the execution of the present Agreement and during a three (3) year period from its termination, Customer shall decide, at any time and subject to the respect of a prior notice of ten (10) working days, to carry out directly or to have carried out by a third party of its choice one or several audit(s).  <\/p><p>20.2 Notwithstanding the above, in case of the occurrence of any incident, Customer reserves the right to carry out or to have carried out by a third party of its choice a relevant audit within a reasonable and expedited timeframe and, in any case, within less than ten (10) days.  <\/p><p>20.3 The Supplier undertakes to authorize Customer and/or its Affiliates to carry out investigations in its premises and/or in the premises of any third party intervening within the scope of the present Agreement on behalf of the Supplier.  Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, Customer and/or its duly authorized representative(s) will have the right to audit (i) time sheets of Supplier staff (even if such time sheets are not necessary to calculate the fees payable to Supplier), (ii) documentation, invoices and receipts supporting or pertaining to any expenses, and (iii) other documentation and information reasonably related to the Services and/or the manner of calculating the compensation payable to Supplier pursuant to the Technical Appendix. Customer will not have access to personnel information that is prohibited by applicable law. <\/p><p>Customer its Affiliates and/or its authorized representative will have access to Supplier’s facilities, will be allowed to interview employees of Supplier with respect to matters pertinent to this Agreement, will have access to all records, and will be furnished (without charge) adequate and appropriate workspace in order to perform the examinations provided for under this Article 20. <\/p><p>The Supplier shall also give access to any devices, to any data including but not limited to electronic or paper copies of information of the technical environment and/or infrastructure, in order to ensure:   <\/p><p>the compliance by the Supplier of its undertakings in application of the Agreement in particular but not limited to provisions related to Article 21.11 “Code of Conduct – Compliance – Export Control”;   <\/p><p>the compliance of the technical and organizational measures related to the physical and logical security, the back-up and the service continuity by the Supplier as set out in the relevant Appendices;   <\/p><p>the information security certifications as required under article “Security and Data Processing” <\/p><p>the compliance of a legal provision or any other relevant regulation in particular in terms of internal control or according to the European Regulation or any other relevant legislation.  <\/p><p>The Supplier undertakes to provide all necessary means, information and assistance for the good carrying out of audits. Customer shall undertake its reasonable best efforts in order not to disturb the Supplier activity.  <\/p><p>20.4 Customer shall support all expenses related to any audit.  However, if the audit reveals a breach by the Supplier of its obligations, including an overcharge of more than five percent (5%) during any calendar year (or during the applicable audit period, if shorter) or Supplier’s noncompliance with the Customer Cybersecurity Rules then, all the expenses paid by Customer related to the audit shall be completely re-invoiced to the Supplier. In addition, Customer reserves the right to apply any other provisions related to penalties and termination in accordance with this Agreement. <\/p><p>If the audit reveals a breach by the Supplier of its obligations according to the present Agreement, the relevant legislations or regulations applicable in its quality of service provider, Customer can request the Supplier to take, in deadlines to be disclosed to it by any means, all necessary measures to remedy to these breaches. The present article applies without prejudice to the possibility for Customer to request, in case of any aforementioned breaches, the termination of the Agreement for breach by the Supplier. <\/p>", "text": "20.1 During the execution of the present Agreement and during a three (3) year period from its termination, Customer shall decide, at any time and subject to the respect of a prior notice of ten (10) working days, to carry out directly or to have carried out by a third party of its choice one or several audit(s).  \n20.2 Notwithstanding the above, in case of the occurrence of any incident, Customer reserves the right to carry out or to have carried out by a third party of its choice a relevant audit within a reasonable and expedited timeframe and, in any case, within less than ten (10) days.  \n20.3 The Supplier undertakes to authorize Customer and/or its Affiliates to carry out investigations in its premises and/or in the premises of any third party intervening within the scope of the present Agreement on behalf of the Supplier.  Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, Customer and/or its duly authorized representative(s) will have the right to audit (i) time sheets of Supplier staff (even if such time sheets are not necessary to calculate the fees payable to Supplier), (ii) documentation, invoices and receipts supporting or pertaining to any expenses, and (iii) other documentation and information reasonably related to the Services and/or the manner of calculating the compensation payable to Supplier pursuant to the Technical Appendix. Customer will not have access to personnel information that is prohibited by applicable law. \nCustomer its Affiliates and/or its authorized representative will have access to Supplier’s facilities, will be allowed to interview employees of Supplier with respect to matters pertinent to this Agreement, will have access to all records, and will be furnished (without charge) adequate and appropriate workspace in order to perform the examinations provided for under this Article 20. \nThe Supplier shall also give access to any devices, to any data including but not limited to electronic or paper copies of information of the technical environment and/or infrastructure, in order to ensure:   \nthe compliance by the Supplier of its undertakings in application of the Agreement in particular but not limited to provisions related to Article 21.11 “Code of Conduct – Compliance – Export Control”;   \nthe compliance of the technical and organizational measures related to the physical and logical security, the back-up and the service continuity by the Supplier as set out in the relevant Appendices;   \nthe information security certifications as required under article “Security and Data Processing” \nthe compliance of a legal provision or any other relevant regulation in particular in terms of internal control or according to the European Regulation or any other relevant legislation.  \nThe Supplier undertakes to provide all necessary means, information and assistance for the good carrying out of audits. Customer shall undertake its reasonable best efforts in order not to disturb the Supplier activity.  \n20.4 Customer shall support all expenses related to any audit.  However, if the audit reveals a breach by the Supplier of its obligations, including an overcharge of more than five percent (5%) during any calendar year (or during the applicable audit period, if shorter) or Supplier’s noncompliance with the Customer Cybersecurity Rules then, all the expenses paid by Customer related to the audit shall be completely re-invoiced to the Supplier. In addition, Customer reserves the right to apply any other provisions related to penalties and termination in accordance with this Agreement. \nIf the audit reveals a breach by the Supplier of its obligations according to the present Agreement, the relevant legislations or regulations applicable in its quality of service provider, Customer can request the Supplier to take, in deadlines to be disclosed to it by any means, all necessary measures to remedy to these breaches. The present article applies without prejudice to the possibility for Customer to request, in case of any aforementioned breaches, the termination of the Agreement for breach by the Supplier. "}, {"id": "d0-s45", "doc": 0, "title": "21.1. No waiver", "html": "<p>The failure of either Party at any time to require performance by the other Party of any provision of the Framework Agreement or a Statement of Work will in no way affect the right to require such performance at any time thereafter, nor will the waiver of either party of a breach of any provision of the Framework Agreement or a Statement of Work constitute a waiver of any succeeding breach of the same or any other provision<\/p>", "text": "The failure of either Party at any time to require performance by the other Party of any provision of the Framework Agreement or a Statement of Work will in no way affect the right to require such performance at any time thereafter, nor will the waiver of either party of a breach of any provision of the Framework Agreement or a Statement of Work constitute a waiver of any succeeding breach of the same or any other provision"}, {"id": "d0-s46", "doc": 0, "title": "21.3. Notifications", "html": "<p>Any notification shall be addressed to the other Party’s registered office. However any notifications sent by the Supplier to the registered office of Customer shall also be sent to the following address:<\/p>", "text": "Any notification shall be addressed to the other Party’s registered office. However any notifications sent by the Supplier to the registered office of Customer shall also be sent to the following address:"}, {"id": "d0-s47", "doc": 0, "title": "21.4. Severability", "html": "<p>Whenever possible, each provision of this Agreement will be interpreted in such a manner as to be effective and valid under the applicable law, but if any term of this Framework Agreement or a Statement of Work is invalid or unenforceable under applicable law or regulation, such term will be deemed reformed or deleted, as the case may be, but only to the extent necessary to comply with such applicable law or regulation, and the remaining provisions of the Framework Agreement or a Statement of Work will remain in full force and effect.<\/p>", "text": "Whenever possible, each provision of this Agreement will be interpreted in such a manner as to be effective and valid under the applicable law, but if any term of this Framework Agreement or a Statement of Work is invalid or unenforceable under applicable law or regulation, such term will be deemed reformed or deleted, as the case may be, but only to the extent necessary to comply with such applicable law or regulation, and the remaining provisions of the Framework Agreement or a Statement of Work will remain in full force and effect."}, {"id": "d0-s48", "doc": 0, "title": "21.5. Modification", "html": "<p>The Framework Agreement and/or a Statement of Work can only be modified by means of a written amendment duly executed by both Parties. <\/p>", "text": "The Framework Agreement and/or a Statement of Work can only be modified by means of a written amendment duly executed by both Parties. "}, {"id": "d0-s49", "doc": 0, "title": "21.6. Proof of agreement", "html": "<p>Should Customer issue a request with respect to the call for tender in an electronic form, via the e-consultation tool, accessible by Supplier from the B2B portal of Stellantis, the Agreement and/or any relevant Statement of Work shall be addressed to Supplier via the e-consultation tool. The Supplier shall send back via tool the PDF format of the Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work signed and submit it in the space provided to this end in the e-consultation tool, according to the Customer’s guidelines.   <\/p><p>Customer shall carry out the same steps and submit the PDF version of the Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work executed by both Parties in the space provided to that end in the e-consultation tool. That version of the Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work shall be binding to the Parties and shall prevail over any other paper document.  <\/p><p>The Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work submitted by the Supplier and not objected to by Customer shall be binding between the Parties even absent the signature of Customer.  <\/p><p>Therefore, any document submitted by the Parties in the e-consultation tool shall prevail over any other paper document.   <\/p><p>Notwithstanding the above, Customer shall be entitled to request the Supplier to send to Customer the Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work dated, initialed and signed in two paper copies by postal service.  <\/p>", "text": "Should Customer issue a request with respect to the call for tender in an electronic form, via the e-consultation tool, accessible by Supplier from the B2B portal of Stellantis, the Agreement and/or any relevant Statement of Work shall be addressed to Supplier via the e-consultation tool. The Supplier shall send back via tool the PDF format of the Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work signed and submit it in the space provided to this end in the e-consultation tool, according to the Customer’s guidelines.   \nCustomer shall carry out the same steps and submit the PDF version of the Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work executed by both Parties in the space provided to that end in the e-consultation tool. That version of the Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work shall be binding to the Parties and shall prevail over any other paper document.  \nThe Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work submitted by the Supplier and not objected to by Customer shall be binding between the Parties even absent the signature of Customer.  \nTherefore, any document submitted by the Parties in the e-consultation tool shall prevail over any other paper document.   \nNotwithstanding the above, Customer shall be entitled to request the Supplier to send to Customer the Agreement and/or the relevant Statement of Work dated, initialed and signed in two paper copies by postal service.  "}, {"id": "d0-s50", "doc": 0, "title": "21.7. Surviving clauses", "html": "<p>Upon expiry or termination of the Agreement and/or any relevant Statement of Work, any provisions which may reasonably be construed as intended to survive beyond the expiry or termination of the said Agreement and/or any relevant Statement of Work shall survive beyond such event. Without limitation to the foregoing, the obligations, in particular those provided for under Articles 7 “Intellectual property”, 8 “Warranty”, 9 “Liability – Indemnification”, 10 “Confidentiality”, 12.4 and 12.5 « Termination», 13 “Reversibility – Termination Assistance Services”, 14 “Insurance”, 19 “Security and Data Processing”, 20 “Audit”,  and 22 “Applicable Law – Competent Court”, shall remain in force between the Parties 5 (five) years following the expiration or termination of the Agreement and/or any relevant Statement of Work for whatsoever reason.  <\/p>", "text": "Upon expiry or termination of the Agreement and/or any relevant Statement of Work, any provisions which may reasonably be construed as intended to survive beyond the expiry or termination of the said Agreement and/or any relevant Statement of Work shall survive beyond such event. Without limitation to the foregoing, the obligations, in particular those provided for under Articles 7 “Intellectual property”, 8 “Warranty”, 9 “Liability – Indemnification”, 10 “Confidentiality”, 12.4 and 12.5 « Termination», 13 “Reversibility – Termination Assistance Services”, 14 “Insurance”, 19 “Security and Data Processing”, 20 “Audit”,  and 22 “Applicable Law – Competent Court”, shall remain in force between the Parties 5 (five) years following the expiration or termination of the Agreement and/or any relevant Statement of Work for whatsoever reason.  "}, {"id": "d0-s51", "doc": 0, "title": "21.8. Interpretation", "html": "<p>The headings of the articles of the Framework Agreement or the Statement of works are inserted only for the purpose of facilitating their comprehension and for convenience of reading and do not affect their interpretation in any manner whatsoever. In case of difficulty of interpretation between any such headings and any of the clauses, the content of the clause shall prevail over the heading.<\/p>", "text": "The headings of the articles of the Framework Agreement or the Statement of works are inserted only for the purpose of facilitating their comprehension and for convenience of reading and do not affect their interpretation in any manner whatsoever. In case of difficulty of interpretation between any such headings and any of the clauses, the content of the clause shall prevail over the heading."}, {"id": "d0-s52", "doc": 0, "title": "21.9. Nature of the Relationship of Parties", "html": "<p>Supplier and Customer are independent contracting parties and nothing in this Agreement will make either party the agent or legal representative of the other for any purpose whatsoever, nor does it grant either party any authority to assume or to create any obligation on behalf of or in the name of the other. <\/p>", "text": "Supplier and Customer are independent contracting parties and nothing in this Agreement will make either party the agent or legal representative of the other for any purpose whatsoever, nor does it grant either party any authority to assume or to create any obligation on behalf of or in the name of the other. "}, {"id": "d0-s53", "doc": 0, "title": "21.10 Entire Agreement; Applicability", "html": "<p>This Agreement sets forth the exclusive terms and conditions under which Supplier will sell and Customer will purchase the Service described herein during the Term. Terms and conditions proposed by Supplier that are different from or in addition to the provisions of this Agreement are expressly rejected by Customer and are not a part of this Agreement, and Supplier’s acceptance is expressly limited to the terms of this Agreement.
