in the case that these applications are also including the single sign on capability."}, {"id": "d1-s13", "doc": 1, "title": "Golden rules", "html": "<p>To add as much value as possible, we need to rethink the way we share information.<\/p><p>Thanks to quality contents, <em>DealerX<\/em><em> <\/em>shall help Stellantis to manage simultaneously, on a tailor-made basis for the end-user, and automatically the steps of Change Management like:<\/p><p>Kick-Off: launch of a new car or a new project on transversal approach<\/p><p>Set-up: know-how on vehicle and services, adoption of processes &amp; tools to improve the performance of the dealer<\/p><p><strong>Sustainment:<\/strong> ensuring long-term engagement, continuous learning, and ongoing support for services, programs, and business initiatives to maximize value realization and operational effectiveness.<\/p><p>In addition, the proposed platform should demonstrate the following strategic capabilities:<\/p><p><strong>Reusability by Design:<\/strong> the solution shall maximize the reuse of components, templates, content assets, integrations, and development artifacts across multiple business initiatives, brands, markets, and user journeys, reducing implementation effort and total cost of ownership.<\/p><p><strong>AI-Driven DevOps:<\/strong> the platform should leverage Artificial Intelligence capabilities to enhance development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational activities, improving productivity, quality, release velocity, and overall platform governance.<\/p><p><strong>Seamless Integration with Business-Critical Applications:<\/strong> the solution shall provide robust and scalable integration capabilities with Stellantis core enterprise systems and business-critical applications, ensuring efficient data exchange, process orchestration, and a connected digital ecosystem.<\/p><p><strong>Best-in-Class Content Management System (CMS):<\/strong> the platform shall provide advanced content management capabilities, including content authoring, governance, workflow management, personalization, multi-channel publishing, localization support, and content reuse, enabling business teams to manage and distribute content efficiently with minimal IT dependency.<\/p><p>The proposed solution should clearly demonstrate how these capabilities contribute to faster business adoption, improved operational efficiency, enhanced user experience, and long-term platform scalability.<\/p><p>Stellantis will provide strategic inputs on a very regular basis (daily, weekly, or monthly depending on the timeline and sensitivity). Stellantis will provide the goal to be aimed and the items / assets. <\/p><p>With the material and goals, the Platform and the Provider shall support Stellantis in the following tasks:<\/p><p>Propose marketing strategies adapted to context, brand, perimeter by using all functionalities of the Global Dealer Dev Tool. Those strategies will be aligned on the capacity of Stellantis entities, the maturity of the targets etc. <\/p><p>Deploy this strategy through the Global Dealer Dev Tool<\/p><p>Monitor &amp; measure the impact of this deployment and strategy by performing regular return of experience and by applying a strong tagging plan for all posts<\/p><p>The platform should allow for easy upload and management of contents with attractive look and feel to allow the following features:<\/p><p>Easy to understand  / straight to the point : main information in 2 lines <\/p><p>Easy to find: centralize at the same place with a powerful search engine (on the content basis),<\/p><p>Classification of contents by Brand / Country / theme / project (generic sense) / keywords.  <\/p><p>Personalized according to the priorities of the activity and to the performance<\/p><p>Notifications + highlight on main priorities<\/p><p>Help to improve business: better knowledge and better knowhow<\/p><p>It should drive behaviour: <\/p><p>Contents is linked to user profile and preferences <\/p><p>Every user gets the attention on what they need to know, based on Stellantis published content <\/p>", "text": "To add as much value as possible, we need to rethink the way we share information.\nThanks to quality contents, DealerX shall help Stellantis to manage simultaneously, on a tailor-made basis for the end-user, and automatically the steps of Change Management like:\nKick-Off: launch of a new car or a new project on transversal approach\nSet-up: know-how on vehicle and services, adoption of processes & tools to improve the performance of the dealer\nSustainment: ensuring long-term engagement, continuous learning, and ongoing support for services, programs, and business initiatives to maximize value realization and operational effectiveness.\nIn addition, the proposed platform should demonstrate the following strategic capabilities:\nReusability by Design: the solution shall maximize the reuse of components, templates, content assets, integrations, and development artifacts across multiple business initiatives, brands, markets, and user journeys, reducing implementation effort and total cost of ownership.\nAI-Driven DevOps: the platform should leverage Artificial Intelligence capabilities to enhance development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational activities, improving productivity, quality, release velocity, and overall platform governance.\nSeamless Integration with Business-Critical Applications: the solution shall provide robust and scalable integration capabilities with Stellantis core enterprise systems and business-critical applications, ensuring efficient data exchange, process orchestration, and a connected digital ecosystem.\nBest-in-Class Content Management System (CMS): the platform shall provide advanced content management capabilities, including content authoring, governance, workflow management, personalization, multi-channel publishing, localization support, and content reuse, enabling business teams to manage and distribute content efficiently with minimal IT dependency.\nThe proposed solution should clearly demonstrate how these capabilities contribute to faster business adoption, improved operational efficiency, enhanced user experience, and long-term platform scalability.\nStellantis will provide strategic inputs on a very regular basis (daily, weekly, or monthly depending on the timeline and sensitivity). Stellantis will provide the goal to be aimed and the items / assets. \nWith the material and goals, the Platform and the Provider shall support Stellantis in the following tasks:\nPropose marketing strategies adapted to context, brand, perimeter by using all functionalities of the Global Dealer Dev Tool. Those strategies will be aligned on the capacity of Stellantis entities, the maturity of the targets etc. \nDeploy this strategy through the Global Dealer Dev Tool\nMonitor & measure the impact of this deployment and strategy by performing regular return of experience and by applying a strong tagging plan for all posts\nThe platform should allow for easy upload and management of contents with attractive look and feel to allow the following features:\nEasy to understand  / straight to the point : main information in 2 lines \nEasy to find: centralize at the same place with a powerful search engine (on the content basis),\nClassification of contents by Brand / Country / theme / project (generic sense) / keywords.  \nPersonalized according to the priorities of the activity and to the performance\nNotifications + highlight on main priorities\nHelp to improve business: better knowledge and better knowhow\nIt should drive behaviour: \nContents is linked to user profile and preferences \nEvery user gets the attention on what they need to know, based on Stellantis published content "}, {"id": "d1-s14", "doc": 1, "title": "Contents management", "html": "<p>Content Management shall be based on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), which is already implemented and actively used across other corporate portals. The existing Adobe-based architecture and toolset should be considered the current baseline for the solution, ensuring consistency, reuse of established capabilities, and alignment with the Stellantis digital ecosystem.<\/p><p>Suppliers are expected to leverage the existing AEM platform and architecture as the starting point for their proposed solution. However, the current architecture should not be considered an inflexible requirement.<\/p><p> Where the proposed use cases would benefit from alternative approaches, architectural enhancements, optimizations, or recommendations may be proposed, provided that they clearly demonstrate added value, improved scalability, maintainability, integration capabilities, or business benefits. Stellantis remains open to evaluating architecture improvements as part of the overall proposal.<\/p><p>The proposed solution shall support business-user autonomy in content management activities. In particular, the availability of intuitive authoring capabilities, including support for the <strong>Adobe Universal Editor<\/strong> or equivalent functionality, is considered a key requirement to enable distributed content creation and maintenance by business users without reliance on centralized development or support teams.<\/p><p>Suppliers should adopt modern development principles and best practices, focusing on component reusability, platform alignment, standardization, scalability, and AI-driven development capabilities. Rather than adhering to predefined control rules, proposals should demonstrate how the solution promotes efficient delivery, long-term maintainability, and the ability to evolve in line with future business and technology requirements.<\/p><p>Any proposed enhancements, evolutions, or changes should therefore balance compliance with the existing platform foundation and the ability to introduce innovative improvements that further strengthen the overall digital experience and operational efficiency.<\/p><p>The Creation: <\/p><p>Created locally or centrally at a region level but accessible for all the NSC, Corporate Staff, ICT, Business folks and additional users base with no added cost. Both ICT and Business / Corporate staff / NSC have access/capability to modify content.<\/p><p>Creator is free to choose the language of the content and this content should be easily or automatically translate in other languages to be able to publish the same contents in multiple countries. <\/p><p>The content editor is already pre-configured to help respect the overall layout and graphic style of the portal <\/p><p>All kind of supports can be published on the platform: article, videos, PDF, PPT, Excel, Word, HTML, photo gallery, external links<\/p><p>Use Universal Editor needs to be a must. Business users should be autonomous<\/p><p>The Publishing:<\/p><p>Full Autonomy of Stellantis for publishing &amp; editing contents<\/p><p>Possible delegation of communication rights to animators (local, internal, or external)<\/p><p>The recipients of the publications can be chosen: <\/p><p>According to the profile: brands, business community, dealers, functions, project <\/p><p>The content can be saved at different stage:<\/p><p>As a draft, to see what it would like without being visible for the community<\/p><p>Save and posted: immediately visible on the platform<\/p><p>Save and delay: only visible in the future at a date specified by the user <\/p><p>Interaction with the content is possible:<\/p><p>Ability to comment<\/p><p>Ability to share <\/p><p>Ability to like or vote  <\/p><p>The follow up:<\/p><p>Monitoring of the contents should be possible thanks to reports <\/p><p>Linked to the most frequent search in the search engine and the content with the most social interaction, the provider will recommend new contents to create.  <\/p>", "text": "Content Management shall be based on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), which is already implemented and actively used across other corporate portals. The existing Adobe-based architecture and toolset should be considered the current baseline for the solution, ensuring consistency, reuse of established capabilities, and alignment with the Stellantis digital ecosystem.\nSuppliers are expected to leverage the existing AEM platform and architecture as the starting point for their proposed solution. However, the current architecture should not be considered an inflexible requirement.\n Where the proposed use cases would benefit from alternative approaches, architectural enhancements, optimizations, or recommendations may be proposed, provided that they clearly demonstrate added value, improved scalability, maintainability, integration capabilities, or business benefits. Stellantis remains open to evaluating architecture improvements as part of the overall proposal.\nThe proposed solution shall support business-user autonomy in content management activities. In particular, the availability of intuitive authoring capabilities, including support for the Adobe Universal Editor or equivalent functionality, is considered a key requirement to enable distributed content creation and maintenance by business users without reliance on centralized development or support teams.\nSuppliers should adopt modern development principles and best practices, focusing on component reusability, platform alignment, standardization, scalability, and AI-driven development capabilities. Rather than adhering to predefined control rules, proposals should demonstrate how the solution promotes efficient delivery, long-term maintainability, and the ability to evolve in line with future business and technology requirements.\nAny proposed enhancements, evolutions, or changes should therefore balance compliance with the existing platform foundation and the ability to introduce innovative improvements that further strengthen the overall digital experience and operational efficiency.\nThe Creation: \nCreated locally or centrally at a region level but accessible for all the NSC, Corporate Staff, ICT, Business folks and additional users base with no added cost. Both ICT and Business / Corporate staff / NSC have access/capability to modify content.\nCreator is free to choose the language of the content and this content should be easily or automatically translate in other languages to be able to publish the same contents in multiple countries. \nThe content editor is already pre-configured to help respect the overall layout and graphic style of the portal \nAll kind of supports can be published on the platform: article, videos, PDF, PPT, Excel, Word, HTML, photo gallery, external links\nUse Universal Editor needs to be a must. Business users should be autonomous\nThe Publishing:\nFull Autonomy of Stellantis for publishing & editing contents\nPossible delegation of communication rights to animators (local, internal, or external)\nThe recipients of the publications can be chosen: \nAccording to the profile: brands, business community, dealers, functions, project \nThe content can be saved at different stage:\nAs a draft, to see what it would like without being visible for the community\nSave and posted: immediately visible on the platform\nSave and delay: only visible in the future at a date specified by the user \nInteraction with the content is possible:\nAbility to comment\nAbility to share \nAbility to like or vote  \nThe follow up:\nMonitoring of the contents should be possible thanks to reports \nLinked to the most frequent search in the search engine and the content with the most social interaction, the provider will recommend new contents to create.  "}, {"id": "d1-s15", "doc": 1, "title": "Documentation (File Repository)", "html": "<p>Dealers will be able to find a structure repository of documentation that they will be able to view online or download.<\/p><p>The access to find and view the documents will be based on the user profile parameters.<\/p>", "text": "Dealers will be able to find a structure repository of documentation that they will be able to view online or download.\nThe access to find and view the documents will be based on the user profile parameters."}, {"id": "d1-s16", "doc": 1, "title": "File Volumes and file types", "html": "<p>The solution should allow for big files like high-definition images and videos to be uploaded and downloaded.<\/p><p>It should not be constraint in terms of scalability of content volumes to hundreds of Terabytes of data,<\/p><p>A preview of the content must be available for the final customer.<\/p><p>The provider has to describe how the big file management will be managed, what is the technical solution has to put in place, what are the licence needed, in case of an external repository the supplier has to provide a high level estimation of external costs (using price list).<\/p>", "text": "The solution should allow for big files like high-definition images and videos to be uploaded and downloaded.\nIt should not be constraint in terms of scalability of content volumes to hundreds of Terabytes of data,\nA preview of the content must be available for the final customer.\nThe provider has to describe how the big file management will be managed, what is the technical solution has to put in place, what are the licence needed, in case of an external repository the supplier has to provide a high level estimation of external costs (using price list)."}, {"id": "d1-s17", "doc": 1, "title": "Ticketing Solution (Dealer Case/Inquiries/Claims)", "html": "<p>Whenever Dealers will not find within the portal or in the application behind the answer to what they are looking for, the portal should allow the dealer to be able to open a case or ticket where the dealer will ask for support to Stellantis teams.<\/p><p>The solution should allow the creation of different type of tickets, including specific forms, with different type of fields. It also should allow the possibility to attach files to the tickets, both by the dealers or by Stellantis users, to help on the understanding and resolution of the problem that trigger the creation of the ticket.<\/p><p>The ticketing capabilities of the tool should be able to be ingested by Stellantis made solution but being as well fully operational and integrated with ServiceNow ticketing solutions, which will be the target Stellantis solution for ticketing. <\/p><p>The solution should integrate with <strong>DIGITALME <\/strong>system to support the creation of tickets in Sales business processes. The ability for the user to create/update/view the tickets in DigitalMe. The tool should automatically collect the context of the page the user is in and include the details in the ticket. The user should have the ability to create the tickets from within the Portal.    <\/p><p>The solution should allow for an easy management of the ticket queue, including bulk modification features, possibility to download information on the tickets, reassignment of ticket, and reporting tools to understand different KPIs associated to the creation and response of the tickets.<\/p><p>The solution should allow the easy integration with external sources to be able to import useful data to be used in the ticket creation or management (i.e: import applicable commercial campaign in the case of a dealer incentive claim, or the dealer order portfolio for the creation of a ticket related to problems in the delivery of one of the vehicles ordered by a dealer) or for other use cases (e.g. to support aftersales parts ordering).<\/p><p>Additionally moving from a session to another, it’s important that the solution keeps the main data (eg VIN, customer info, etc) to smooth the user navigation and avoid retyping data. <\/p>", "text": "Whenever Dealers will not find within the portal or in the application behind the answer to what they are looking for, the portal should allow the dealer to be able to open a case or ticket where the dealer will ask for support to Stellantis teams.\nThe solution should allow the creation of different type of tickets, including specific forms, with different type of fields. It also should allow the possibility to attach files to the tickets, both by the dealers or by Stellantis users, to help on the understanding and resolution of the problem that trigger the creation of the ticket.\nThe ticketing capabilities of the tool should be able to be ingested by Stellantis made solution but being as well fully operational and integrated with ServiceNow ticketing solutions, which will be the target Stellantis solution for ticketing. \nThe solution should integrate with DIGITALME system to support the creation of tickets in Sales business processes. The ability for the user to create/update/view the tickets in DigitalMe. The tool should automatically collect the context of the page the user is in and include the details in the ticket. The user should have the ability to create the tickets from within the Portal.    \nThe solution should allow for an easy management of the ticket queue, including bulk modification features, possibility to download information on the tickets, reassignment of ticket, and reporting tools to understand different KPIs associated to the creation and response of the tickets.\nThe solution should allow the easy integration with external sources to be able to import useful data to be used in the ticket creation or management (i.e: import applicable commercial campaign in the case of a dealer incentive claim, or the dealer order portfolio for the creation of a ticket related to problems in the delivery of one of the vehicles ordered by a dealer) or for other use cases (e.g. to support aftersales parts ordering).\nAdditionally moving from a session to another, it’s important that the solution keeps the main data (eg VIN, customer info, etc) to smooth the user navigation and avoid retyping data. "}, {"id": "d1-s18", "doc": 1, "title": "Social Interactions", "html": "<p>The solution should allow for users to interact easily between them, empowering the community of dealers and Stellantis users to help each other, and stay connected.<\/p>", "text": "The solution should allow for users to interact easily between them, empowering the community of dealers and Stellantis users to help each other, and stay connected."}, {"id": "d1-s19", "doc": 1, "title": "Forum", "html": "<p>The solution should optionally allow any user (Dealer, Stellantis NSCs, Central users), to interact, that will be visible by the applicable community of that user (based on user profile parameters, like country, brand, etc..), and will allow for other users to react. <\/p><p>The main purpose of this feature is not only to allow a Bottom-up communication, from dealers to Stellantis, but also to create the feeling of being part of an Stellantis community, where any part of the community could share views, help each other, and talk openly.<\/p><p>Nevertheless, this forum should allow Stellantis Community management users to apply restrictions to the interactions in case users make an abusive use of this forum.<\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p>", "text": "The solution should optionally allow any user (Dealer, Stellantis NSCs, Central users), to interact, that will be visible by the applicable community of that user (based on user profile parameters, like country, brand, etc..), and will allow for other users to react. \nThe main purpose of this feature is not only to allow a Bottom-up communication, from dealers to Stellantis, but also to create the feeling of being part of an Stellantis community, where any part of the community could share views, help each other, and talk openly.\nNevertheless, this forum should allow Stellantis Community management users to apply restrictions to the interactions in case users make an abusive use of this forum.\n"}, {"id": "d1-s20", "doc": 1, "title": "Comments and feedback on content", "html": "<p>The solution should also allow the comments of all users on the content that is being shared and published by Stellantis, either in the form of News or also in other formats like knowledge articles visible through ticket deflection and Self-help, and Documentation uploaded to the portal.<\/p>", "text": "The solution should also allow the comments of all users on the content that is being shared and published by Stellantis, either in the form of News or also in other formats like knowledge articles visible through ticket deflection and Self-help, and Documentation uploaded to the portal."}, {"id": "d1-s21", "doc": 1, "title": "Development framework", "html": "<p>The solution will be the entry point to connect all back-office functions exposed via Integration Layer supporting dealer and repairer business: since the current landscape foresees a wide variety of applications, framework integration capabilities are customize the connection and ensure a smooth transition is needed. This development framework should be accessible to multi-providers and ensure the SW robustness of the platform. It will allow continuous integration and delivery (leveraging Stellantis DevSecOps chain tools). The concept is to enhance and extend a “DealerX SDK” where any Integrator/ IT Dev would be able to smoothly build and implement features for the portal. We currently use multiple environments, namely, Dev, Test, Stage and Prod.  The solution should allow for the applications to utilize standard style sheet and common components.   <\/p><p>Standard Stellantis Development Guidelines are provided in the ‘Development_Standards_Stellantis.pdf’ available with this RFQ. <\/p>", "text": "The solution will be the entry point to connect all back-office functions exposed via Integration Layer supporting dealer and repairer business: since the current landscape foresees a wide variety of applications, framework integration capabilities are customize the connection and ensure a smooth transition is needed. This development framework should be accessible to multi-providers and ensure the SW robustness of the platform. It will allow continuous integration and delivery (leveraging Stellantis DevSecOps chain tools). The concept is to enhance and extend a “DealerX SDK” where any Integrator/ IT Dev would be able to smoothly build and implement features for the portal. We currently use multiple environments, namely, Dev, Test, Stage and Prod.  The solution should allow for the applications to utilize standard style sheet and common components.   \nStandard Stellantis Development Guidelines are provided in the ‘Development_Standards_Stellantis.pdf’ available with this RFQ. "}, {"id": "d1-s22", "doc": 1, "title": "Stellantis Dealer and Repairer master data interface", "html": "<p>Dealer masterdata is handled in specific Stellantis applications: a daily interface has been used to keep the dealer master data up to date. Stellantis has previously used ARCAD and WEBDAC as sources of dealer master data, and from December 2026 the new Stellantis Network Referential (SNR) will be the primary source of dealer master data.<\/p>", "text": "Dealer masterdata is handled in specific Stellantis applications: a daily interface has been used to keep the dealer master data up to date. Stellantis has previously used ARCAD and WEBDAC as sources of dealer master data, and from December 2026 the new Stellantis Network Referential (SNR) will be the primary source of dealer master data."}, {"id": "d1-s23", "doc": 1, "title": "Dealer and HQ access (Single Sign on)", "html": "<p>The user authentication and profiling solution is already in place and validated for Dealerx platform. It will be the same across all EE Region.<\/p><p>The Stellantis Group has decided to move to the exFCA solution to authenticate and authorize the Stellantis dealers: <\/p><p>Stellantis PingFed for user authentication (+ MFA for HQ users) <\/p><p>Mypeople application for user authorization (profile management) <\/p>", "text": "The user authentication and profiling solution is already in place and validated for Dealerx platform. It will be the same across all EE Region.\nThe Stellantis Group has decided to move to the exFCA solution to authenticate and authorize the Stellantis dealers: \nStellantis PingFed for user authentication (+ MFA for HQ users) \nMypeople application for user authorization (profile management) "}, {"id": "d1-s24", "doc": 1, "title": "Search engine", "html": "<p>From the user’s perspective, it must be possible to find each content very easily through the search engine. It must allow a word search on content, comments, users and file attachments and inside different part of the content (title, body of the content, text, picture and video). Search tool should incorporate AI to generate meaningful search results based on the context, as well as “assistance companion chatbot” capabilities.   <\/p><p>The search feature automatically takes into account the view permission in phase of proposition results.<\/p><p>This allow the search engine to be completely configured and customized to address any kind of needs, and specifically:<\/p><p>Personalize search results based on user profile<\/p><p>Apply and combine any type of filters<\/p><p>Customize scoring to boost specific items (i.e: most red articles)<\/p><p>Enrich search results with recommendations<\/p><p>Some users will have direct access to and easy search inside: <\/p><p>Tools and applications<\/p><p>News <\/p><p>Documentation<\/p><p>Ticket creation<\/p><p>Seamless connection to other tools:<\/p><p>IMPORTANT allow connection to new STELLANTIS apps and tools, in a transparent way for end-user to increase end-users experience depending on needs (interface with LMS, Quality Portal, CRM, ERP, self-evaluation tools, Service box, MyMarque etc.)<\/p><p>Access to these other applications will depend on the applicative services associated with the user profiles. The tool should not manage the access rights to other applications, but should allow for the applications to be displayed/highlighted based on the user profile<\/p><p>Connections to 3’rd party or externally hosted applications need to be through Single Sign on and does not require the dealer (repairer) to provide a second logon / id.<\/p><p>Some other users will have additional access as:<\/p><p>Content management system ( to create/upload content, articles, etc..)<\/p><p>Including Bulk upload of content/articles<\/p><p>Upload of Documentation<\/p><p>Including bulk upload of documents<\/p><p>Community management<\/p><p>To allow management of social interactions<\/p><p>Ticketing admin/fulfiller module<\/p><p>To be able to manage and respond to dealer tickets, reassign them within Stellantis or to external teams.<\/p><p>Reduce non-productive time:<\/p><p>Simple workflow<\/p><p>Personalize contents <\/p><p>Easy reuse of contents<\/p><p>Automatic translation of contents<\/p><p>Easy management of dealer social interactions<\/p><p>Fast and easy response to dealer tickets/cases/inquiries<\/p><p>Notifications<\/p><p>Audit <\/p><p>Reports of most common search criteria<\/p><p>Reports for tickets<\/p><p>Reports for Most read articles <\/p><p>Reports of most downloaded or viewed documents<\/p>", "text": "From the user’s perspective, it must be possible to find each content very easily through the search engine. It must allow a word search on content, comments, users and file attachments and inside different part of the content (title, body of the content, text, picture and video). Search tool should incorporate AI to generate meaningful search results based on the context, as well as “assistance companion chatbot” capabilities.   \nThe search feature automatically takes into account the view permission in phase of proposition results.\nThis allow the search engine to be completely configured and customized to address any kind of needs, and specifically:\nPersonalize search results based on user profile\nApply and combine any type of filters\nCustomize scoring to boost specific items (i.e: most red articles)\nEnrich search results with recommendations\nSome users will have direct access to and easy search inside: \nTools and applications\nNews \nDocumentation\nTicket creation\nSeamless connection to other tools:\nIMPORTANT allow connection to new STELLANTIS apps and tools, in a transparent way for end-user to increase end-users experience depending on needs (interface with LMS, Quality Portal, CRM, ERP, self-evaluation tools, Service box, MyMarque etc.)\nAccess to these other applications will depend on the applicative services associated with the user profiles. The tool should not manage the access rights to other applications, but should allow for the applications to be displayed/highlighted based on the user profile\nConnections to 3’rd party or externally hosted applications need to be through Single Sign on and does not require the dealer (repairer) to provide a second logon / id.\nSome other users will have additional access as:\nContent management system ( to create/upload content, articles, etc..)\nIncluding Bulk upload of content/articles\nUpload of Documentation\nIncluding bulk upload of documents\nCommunity management\nTo allow management of social interactions\nTicketing admin/fulfiller module\nTo be able to manage and respond to dealer tickets, reassign them within Stellantis or to external teams.\nReduce non-productive time:\nSimple workflow\nPersonalize contents \nEasy reuse of contents\nAutomatic translation of contents\nEasy management of dealer social interactions\nFast and easy response to dealer tickets/cases/inquiries\nNotifications\nAudit \nReports of most common search criteria\nReports for tickets\nReports for Most read articles \nReports of most downloaded or viewed documents"}, {"id": "d1-s25", "doc": 1, "title": "Back-office users & user roles", "html": "<p>The Provider Back-Office solution comes with a standard user management framework to handle a multitude of users and roles.  <\/p><p><strong>Access:<\/strong> A user from a specific user group can access the feature or not<\/p><p><strong>View only:<\/strong> A user from a specific user group has ‘view only’ mode<\/p><p><strong>Modify<\/strong>: A user from a specific user group has ‘modify’ mode<\/p><p>The access can also be restricted per feature or per functionality inside the platform.<\/p><p>Lists of user groups will be managed during set-up phase as well as the back office. There is no limitation on the number of groups that can be created, and user groups can be fully defined by Stellantis and brand teams.<\/p><p>The platform is flexible enough to cater for all levels of visibility – from brand specific users (e.g. Vauxhall UK) to market groups (e.g. PCD UK, OV UK, FCA UK) to global views and access (e.g. Stellantis Global). <\/p><p>Back-office user access will be also able to restrict by the following dimensions:<\/p><p>Brand<\/p><p>Country<\/p><p>There will also be a Super Admin User who will be able to manage functionality across those brand/country dimensions.  <\/p><p>A System Administrator will be able to create a user with a permission to only access content management for a specific brand in a specific country or the user will be able to manage contents for a specific brand.<\/p><p>Due to the fact that the Digital platform shall manage a complex matrix organization of several users communities from different brands and activities, user should be able to choose his dominant profile on the platform. So that, he will be targeted with only the contents linked to his dominant profile. <\/p><p>For some regions, there may be a need for ‘super admin’ the capability to ‘impersonate a user’. That is the ability to logon as that user to see what that user is seeing on the screen.   <\/p>", "text": "The Provider Back-Office solution comes with a standard user management framework to handle a multitude of users and roles.  \nAccess: A user from a specific user group can access the feature or not\nView only: A user from a specific user group has ‘view only’ mode\nModify: A user from a specific user group has ‘modify’ mode\nThe access can also be restricted per feature or per functionality inside the platform.\nLists of user groups will be managed during set-up phase as well as the back office. There is no limitation on the number of groups that can be created, and user groups can be fully defined by Stellantis and brand teams.\nThe platform is flexible enough to cater for all levels of visibility – from brand specific users (e.g. Vauxhall UK) to market groups (e.g. PCD UK, OV UK, FCA UK) to global views and access (e.g. Stellantis Global). \nBack-office user access will be also able to restrict by the following dimensions:\nBrand\nCountry\nThere will also be a Super Admin User who will be able to manage functionality across those brand/country dimensions.  \nA System Administrator will be able to create a user with a permission to only access content management for a specific brand in a specific country or the user will be able to manage contents for a specific brand.\nDue to the fact that the Digital platform shall manage a complex matrix organization of several users communities from different brands and activities, user should be able to choose his dominant profile on the platform. So that, he will be targeted with only the contents linked to his dominant profile. \nFor some regions, there may be a need for ‘super admin’ the capability to ‘impersonate a user’. That is the ability to logon as that user to see what that user is seeing on the screen.   "}, {"id": "d1-s26", "doc": 1, "title": "KPI and Analytics", "html": "<p>The Global DealerX Dev Platform must have an analytics integration with necessary Analytics tools already widely used in Stellantis (as PowerBI FOR DASHBOARDS, Foundry, etc.) as well as ensuring page tagging which will allow to track overall navigation, sales and conversion performances by country/dealers/sales and aftersales categories. Each page should have the same data collection to get a unified analytics system to include DynaTrace and other technologies as appropriate. <\/p>", "text": "The Global DealerX Dev Platform must have an analytics integration with necessary Analytics tools already widely used in Stellantis (as PowerBI FOR DASHBOARDS, Foundry, etc.) as well as ensuring page tagging which will allow to track overall navigation, sales and conversion performances by country/dealers/sales and aftersales categories. Each page should have the same data collection to get a unified analytics system to include DynaTrace and other technologies as appropriate. "}, {"id": "d1-s27", "doc": 1, "title": "Integration Layer", "html": "<p>The application must be able to integrate with backoffice applications through an integration layer supporting sync and async data exchange, batch file, API and webservices. <\/p><p>New Platform should be able to support complex API integration capability to ensure the flow between Platform and Legacy App backends is fluent and robust.<\/p><p>Here below you can find STELLANTIS API topology &amp; consumer guidelines, with additional elements to be shared if required. The core documentation associated with API, Integration and Data Platform usage within Stellantis is available here: API, Integration and Data Platforms<\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p>", "text": "The application must be able to integrate with backoffice applications through an integration layer supporting sync and async data exchange, batch file, API and webservices. \nNew Platform should be able to support complex API integration capability to ensure the flow between Platform and Legacy App backends is fluent and robust.\nHere below you can find STELLANTIS API topology & consumer guidelines, with additional elements to be shared if required. The core documentation associated with API, Integration and Data Platform usage within Stellantis is available here: API, Integration and Data Platforms\n"}, {"id": "d1-s28", "doc": 1, "title": "DevSecOps & DealerX SDK concept", "html": "<p>As previously shared, Stellantis is having a DevSecOps toolchain and requirements to leverage and respect. <\/p><p>DevOps chain should be the way to continuously deliver and maintain the portals product, ensuring flexible and easy integration of new features /components/ widgets into portals with no bottlenecks. <\/p><p>DevSecOps chain architecture in a nutshell is presented on the drawing below as well as requirements for the usage: <\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p><p>The core documentation associated with Dev Ops and Dev Sec Ops in Stellantis is available here: Cloud DevOps Foundation<\/p><p>Here below is illustrated the New Global Platform structure and how DevSecOps &amp; other parts allow to create a DealerX SDK which will be leveraged to deliver software via this platform by anyone.<\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p>", "text": "As previously shared, Stellantis is having a DevSecOps toolchain and requirements to leverage and respect. \nDevOps chain should be the way to continuously deliver and maintain the portals product, ensuring flexible and easy integration of new features /components/ widgets into portals with no bottlenecks. \nDevSecOps chain architecture in a nutshell is presented on the drawing below as well as requirements for the usage: \n\nThe core documentation associated with Dev Ops and Dev Sec Ops in Stellantis is available here: Cloud DevOps Foundation\nHere below is illustrated the New Global Platform structure and how DevSecOps & other parts allow to create a DealerX SDK which will be leveraged to deliver software via this platform by anyone.\n"}, {"id": "d1-s29", "doc": 1, "title": "Ticketing tools", "html": "<p>The need of Stellantis is to use, fully integrated Legacy ticketing tool or target ServiceNow based ones, which are not the same between Sales and Aftersales for instance. <\/p>", "text": "The need of Stellantis is to use, fully integrated Legacy ticketing tool or target ServiceNow based ones, which are not the same between Sales and Aftersales for instance. "}, {"id": "d1-s30", "doc": 1, "title": "Onboarding phase", "html": "<p>Here detailed are the use cases Stellantis will use to assess technical &amp; functional capabilities of the platforms. We are stressing out the goal of that: Demonstrate to Stellantis End Users, Business and ICT that technologies could deliver the added value each stakeholder is expecting : “best UX/UI and features” for End Users, “best and easiest way to address business Use cases” for Business users, and for ICT “best technology to continuously and smoothly deliver SW to end users, all by remaining integrated in Stellantis infra and tools (DevSecOps toolchain, API Integration Layer, AWS Cloud, etc..) allowing any IT dev around the world to be able to build SW on this STLA Platform by leveraging the “DealerX SDK”.<\/p>", "text": "Here detailed are the use cases Stellantis will use to assess technical & functional capabilities of the platforms. We are stressing out the goal of that: Demonstrate to Stellantis End Users, Business and ICT that technologies could deliver the added value each stakeholder is expecting : “best UX/UI and features” for End Users, “best and easiest way to address business Use cases” for Business users, and for ICT “best technology to continuously and smoothly deliver SW to end users, all by remaining integrated in Stellantis infra and tools (DevSecOps toolchain, API Integration Layer, AWS Cloud, etc..) allowing any IT dev around the world to be able to build SW on this STLA Platform by leveraging the “DealerX SDK”."}, {"id": "d1-s31", "doc": 1, "title": "Landing Page", "html": "<p>Users access the Global Stellantis Landing page, where content is tailored according to their profiles. They can easily navigate to specific Landing pages and have the option to return to the Global Landing from any portal section. <\/p><p>The Global Landing Page should offer:<\/p><p>Bulletin board for general communications to Dealers and a separate one for targeted messages.<\/p><p>Highlights of promotional events, Marketing campaigns, ongoing/upcoming Recall programs.<\/p><p>Dealer-specific dashboard featuring key metrics, KPI gauge charts, sales performance, backorders, VORs, and Retail Inventory levels. <\/p><p>Links to standard Reports, Customizable Reports, Performance analytics, and AI Assisted forecasting tools.<\/p><p>Document management system.<\/p><p>Ticket Management tool, central helpdesk, chatbot, learning, and certification management link.<\/p><p>Portal search engine with auto prompts and suggestions.<\/p><p>Intra-dealer communication tools, Dealer 2 Dealer applications for sales and aftersales activities.<\/p><p>Link to Customer vs Dealer feedback systems and forums.<\/p><p>Display of all user-created tickets and cases on the global landing page.<\/p><p>Notifications for ticket updates and more.<\/p><p>To demonstrate content management capabilities, data is generated as needed with minimal integration to Stellantis applications.<\/p><p><strong>Common elements across all Landing pages include:<\/strong><\/p><p>Standard header structure.<\/p><p>Subscription display.<\/p><p>Administration and settings, language settings, translations, legacy application management, and Dealer General Configuration.<\/p><p>View notifications and promotional messages.<\/p><p>Context-based search bar providing relevant results based on user role.<\/p><p>Seamless navigation between pages with essential information carried forward.<\/p><p>Vehicle selection functionality.<\/p>", "text": "Users access the Global Stellantis Landing page, where content is tailored according to their profiles. They can easily navigate to specific Landing pages and have the option to return to the Global Landing from any portal section. \nThe Global Landing Page should offer:\nBulletin board for general communications to Dealers and a separate one for targeted messages.\nHighlights of promotional events, Marketing campaigns, ongoing/upcoming Recall programs.\nDealer-specific dashboard featuring key metrics, KPI gauge charts, sales performance, backorders, VORs, and Retail Inventory levels. \nLinks to standard Reports, Customizable Reports, Performance analytics, and AI Assisted forecasting tools.\nDocument management system.\nTicket Management tool, central helpdesk, chatbot, learning, and certification management link.\nPortal search engine with auto prompts and suggestions.\nIntra-dealer communication tools, Dealer 2 Dealer applications for sales and aftersales activities.\nLink to Customer vs Dealer feedback systems and forums.\nDisplay of all user-created tickets and cases on the global landing page.\nNotifications for ticket updates and more.\nTo demonstrate content management capabilities, data is generated as needed with minimal integration to Stellantis applications.\nCommon elements across all Landing pages include:\nStandard header structure.\nSubscription display.\nAdministration and settings, language settings, translations, legacy application management, and Dealer General Configuration.\nView notifications and promotional messages.\nContext-based search bar providing relevant results based on user role.\nSeamless navigation between pages with essential information carried forward.\nVehicle selection functionality."}, {"id": "d1-s32", "doc": 1, "title": "DICT / AICT", "html": "<div class=\"tablewrap\"><table><tr><td colspan=\"2\"><strong>DICT SELECTED<\/strong><\/td><td><strong>Criterion<\/strong><\/td><\/tr><tr><td><strong>D / Availability Criteria<\/strong><\/td><td><strong>4<\/strong><\/td><td>Recover system in less than 4 hours<br><\/td><\/tr><tr><td><strong>I / Integrity Criteria<\/strong><\/td><td><strong>2<\/strong><\/td><td>This criterion is analyzed in view of the importance of resources in the identical replacement or to the resetting of Informational Assets subject to alteration, destruction, disappearance, as well as with respect to consecutive immaterial damages (such as loss of production, of profit, etc…).<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><strong>C / Confidentiality Criteria<\/strong><\/td><td><strong>3<\/strong><\/td><td>Disclosure of the information would have a critical impact for the Group (loss of competitive elements, regulatory breach, significant loss of image or trust, etc.).<br>The information is only accessible to a limited number of persons identified by name or role in the Group&#x27;s activities<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><strong>T / Traceability Criteria<\/strong><\/td><td><strong>2<\/strong><\/td><td>The needs for surveillance and control are operational requirements that impose a systematic action (periodic publication or onto event of a state of certain actions or situations): then it is therefore necessary to form and maintain data (date, hour, identities, etc…). <\/td><\/tr><tr><td><strong>DCP Presence (Personal data)<\/strong><\/td><td><strong>Yes<\/strong><\/td><td><\/td><\/tr><\/table><\/div>", "text": "DICT SELECTED\nCriterion\nD / Availability Criteria\n4\nRecover system in less than 4 hours\n\nI / Integrity Criteria\n2\nThis criterion is analyzed in view of the importance of resources in the identical replacement or to the resetting of Informational Assets subject to alteration, destruction, disappearance, as well as with respect to consecutive immaterial damages (such as loss of production, of profit, etc…).\nC / Confidentiality Criteria\n3\nDisclosure of the information would have a critical impact for the Group (loss of competitive elements, regulatory breach, significant loss of image or trust, etc.).\nThe information is only accessible to a limited number of persons identified by name or role in the Group's activities\nT / Traceability Criteria\n2\nThe needs for surveillance and control are operational requirements that impose a systematic action (periodic publication or onto event of a state of certain actions or situations): then it is therefore necessary to form and maintain data (date, hour, identities, etc…). \nDCP Presence (Personal data)\nYes\n"}, {"id": "d1-s33", "doc": 1, "title": "Data Availability", "html": "<p>The application must be designed to provide a greater than 99.75% availability (based on 24/7, 365 days / year). <\/p><p>This means that all data treatments in the platform should be finished by then. This point should also be assessed in the technical requirements.<\/p>", "text": "The application must be designed to provide a greater than 99.75% availability (based on 24/7, 365 days / year). \nThis means that all data treatments in the platform should be finished by then. This point should also be assessed in the technical requirements."}, {"id": "d1-s34", "doc": 1, "title": "Observability", "html": "<p>The solution should be natively integrable with Leading Observability (Dynatrace) . All to allow Stellantis to easily and with flexibility monitor and prevent any issue on the Platform. <\/p>", "text": "The solution should be natively integrable with Leading Observability (Dynatrace) . All to allow Stellantis to easily and with flexibility monitor and prevent any issue on the Platform. "}, {"id": "d1-s35", "doc": 1, "title": "Geographical coverage", "html": "<p>The solution must be able to work Worldwide considering different time zones, languages, regional settings. The Portal needs the capability for ‘Maintenance Windows’ to perform non application related change management with a focus on reducing outages during regional key business hours.<\/p>", "text": "The solution must be able to work Worldwide considering different time zones, languages, regional settings. The Portal needs the capability for ‘Maintenance Windows’ to perform non application related change management with a focus on reducing outages during regional key business hours."}, {"id": "d1-s36", "doc": 1, "title": "Users", "html": "<p>Number of users declared per profile type:<\/p><p><strong>Dealer<\/strong><strong> (global)<\/strong>: 500.000-600.000<\/p><p>The platform should be able to handle the above estimated user volumes, including peak period with up to 80%  users’ connection with different profiles at the same time. This number can evolve at any time in positive or negative.<\/p>", "text": "Number of users declared per profile type:\nDealer (global): 500.000-600.000\nThe platform should be able to handle the above estimated user volumes, including peak period with up to 80%  users’ connection with different profiles at the same time. This number can evolve at any time in positive or negative."}, {"id": "d1-s37", "doc": 1, "title": "Data Privacy", "html": "<p>If the platform manages personal data (customer data), so it must take care of all rules about personal data storage and usage, all across the WW Countries where Stellantis operates.<\/p><p>All data related to the customer are covered by the GDPR rules for data privacy, including VIN number, address, phone number and the link between the client and its orders. <\/p><p>Concerning <strong>customer personal data<\/strong>, the platform should only expose the necessary data (objective: minimize personal data as much as possible). <\/p><p>The technical solution will need to be reviewed during the project and go through an Stellantis Technical Committee.<\/p>", "text": "If the platform manages personal data (customer data), so it must take care of all rules about personal data storage and usage, all across the WW Countries where Stellantis operates.\nAll data related to the customer are covered by the GDPR rules for data privacy, including VIN number, address, phone number and the link between the client and its orders. \nConcerning customer personal data, the platform should only expose the necessary data (objective: minimize personal data as much as possible). \nThe technical solution will need to be reviewed during the project and go through an Stellantis Technical Committee."}, {"id": "d1-s38", "doc": 1, "title": "Project and Service Language", "html": "<p>English will be the main language of the platform support and project documentation. Operative languages are all those of local countries where Stellantis and solution would operate.<\/p>", "text": "English will be the main language of the platform support and project documentation. Operative languages are all those of local countries where Stellantis and solution would operate."}, {"id": "d1-s39", "doc": 1, "title": "Execution report", "html": "<p>An execution report should be generated in order to review the loading process of each data set:<\/p><p>Processing time of the loading process<\/p><p>Treatment: successful or not<\/p><p>Errors <\/p><p>Missing data (data not loaded)<\/p>", "text": "An execution report should be generated in order to review the loading process of each data set:\nProcessing time of the loading process\nTreatment: successful or not\nErrors \nMissing data (data not loaded)"}, {"id": "d1-s40", "doc": 1, "title": "Project plan", "html": "<p>This is the Stellantis conservative plan hypothesis, this plan has to be review accordingly with the supplier better proposal and context of the RFQ.<\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p>", "text": "This is the Stellantis conservative plan hypothesis, this plan has to be review accordingly with the supplier better proposal and context of the RFQ.\n"}, {"id": "d1-s41", "doc": 1, "title": "Security Attachments", "html": "<p>Documents included in this RFQ related to Security include “STELLANTIS CLOUD SECURITY <\/p><p>CONTROLS GUIDELINE” (SSIT-S009-G001), the “Cloud Security Control Checklist” and the “Technical Requirements for Solution Architectures in the Cloud”<\/p><p>In response to the evolving landscape of cybersecurity threats and to strengthen our supply <\/p><p>chain’s resilience, Stellantis is updating its Information Security Requirements for all <\/p><p>suppliers globally. Beginning in Q3 2026, all suppliers supporting Stellantis must hold a <\/p><p>valid TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange) label for each location <\/p><p>involved in delivering goods or services to Stellantis.<\/p><p>It is anticipated that all suppliers are aware of this requirement as it pertains to Indirect Material Suppliers and a copy of the associated communication is also provided in this RFQ for review as “Global TISAX Communication Q4 2025 5.pdf”<\/p><p>If the supplier sees an opportunity to improve the security posture of the existing DealerX platform, this should also be contained within the response. This may include web security protections such as policy management, vulnerability detection, web attacks, DoS attacks, scanning tools, web scrapers and purging in addition or in co-ordination with the defined DevSecOps toolset referenced previously.<\/p>", "text": "Documents included in this RFQ related to Security include “STELLANTIS CLOUD SECURITY \nCONTROLS GUIDELINE” (SSIT-S009-G001), the “Cloud Security Control Checklist” and the “Technical Requirements for Solution Architectures in the Cloud”\nIn response to the evolving landscape of cybersecurity threats and to strengthen our supply \nchain’s resilience, Stellantis is updating its Information Security Requirements for all \nsuppliers globally. Beginning in Q3 2026, all suppliers supporting Stellantis must hold a \nvalid TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange) label for each location \ninvolved in delivering goods or services to Stellantis.\nIt is anticipated that all suppliers are aware of this requirement as it pertains to Indirect Material Suppliers and a copy of the associated communication is also provided in this RFQ for review as “Global TISAX Communication Q4 2025 5.pdf”\nIf the supplier sees an opportunity to improve the security posture of the existing DealerX platform, this should also be contained within the response. This may include web security protections such as policy management, vulnerability detection, web attacks, DoS attacks, scanning tools, web scrapers and purging in addition or in co-ordination with the defined DevSecOps toolset referenced previously."}, {"id": "d1-s42", "doc": 1, "title": "Platforms to be used for the solutions proposal", "html": "<p>The integrator should use the technology solution prosed in the RFI response to demonstrate the same using the POV use cases to allow Stellantis to identify the technology to support global portal for dealers, independent repairer, and central users (HQ + field)<\/p>", "text": "The integrator should use the technology solution prosed in the RFI response to demonstrate the same using the POV use cases to allow Stellantis to identify the technology to support global portal for dealers, independent repairer, and central users (HQ + field)"}, {"id": "d1-s43", "doc": 1, "title": "Expected feedback", "html": "<p>Please provide your <\/p><p>Technical solution to adopt as Stellantis Global DealerX Dev Tool<\/p><p>Proposal for implementation (live in 1 year in EE for independent repairers and dealers who buy from importers on behalf of Stellantis) following agile methodology (biweekly sprint). If additional level of support is optional, please indicate the costs  \nPlease indicate if automatic translation will require additional costs "}, {"id": "d1-s44", "doc": 1, "title": "SLAs", "html": "<p>The following SLA will be in place starting from the pilot phase. The trouble ticketing tool use to manage the incident will be provided by Stellantis.<\/p><p>Any Incident, by definition, should be satisfied as soon as possible. Anyway, in order to be able to prioritize them according to the related urgency for the business operations, each of them is identified by the requester through a particular attribute called User Impact (1, 2, 3, 4)<\/p><p>The agreed Impact Levels, that will be used through this agreement are listed in the following table:<\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p><p>In order to take in count “external” elements that could possibly affect the Impact, as perceived by the end user, e.g. the criticality of the particular software application used when the incident occurred, or the particular day of the month, etc., a prioritization matrix will be used, in order to match the Impact attribute with a second one, called “Urgency”, outputting the final Ticket Priority (1, 2 or 3).<\/p><p>Stellantis standard Priority Matrix<\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p><p>The rules for defining the ticket urgency and/or the user impact level will be agreed for any single in-scope functionalities.<\/p><p>The following indicators will be used to prove the compliancy of the Incident Management Service with the needed customer’s requirements:<\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p><p>(*) for P1 only<\/p><p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\"><\/p>", "text": "The following SLA will be in place starting from the pilot phase. The trouble ticketing tool use to manage the incident will be provided by Stellantis.\nAny Incident, by definition, should be satisfied as soon as possible. Anyway, in order to be able to prioritize them according to the related urgency for the business operations, each of them is identified by the requester through a particular attribute called User Impact (1, 2, 3, 4)\nThe agreed Impact Levels, that will be used through this agreement are listed in the following table:\n\nIn order to take in count “external” elements that could possibly affect the Impact, as perceived by the end user, e.g. the criticality of the particular software application used when the incident occurred, or the particular day of the month, etc., a prioritization matrix will be used, in order to match the Impact attribute with a second one, called “Urgency”, outputting the final Ticket Priority (1, 2 or 3).\nStellantis standard Priority Matrix\n\nThe rules for defining the ticket urgency and/or the user impact level will be agreed for any single in-scope functionalities.\nThe following indicators will be used to prove the compliancy of the Incident Management Service with the needed customer’s requirements:\n\n\n(*) for P1 only\n"}, {"id": "d2-s1", "doc": 2, "title": "Opening & document information", "html": "<p><img loading=\"lazy\" alt=\"Source document figure\" src=\"data:image/jpeg;base64,\"><\/p><p><strong>GDRP SDK Guidelines<\/strong><\/p><p><strong>October 7<\/strong><strong>th<\/strong><strong>,<\/strong><strong> 202<\/strong><strong>5<\/strong><\/p><p><strong>Version <\/strong><strong>1<\/strong><strong>.<\/strong><strong>3<\/strong><\/p><div class=\"tablewrap\"><table><tr><td>Statement of Confidentiality<br>This document contains information that is proprietary and confidential to Stellantis, which shall not be disclosed outside Stellantis, transmitted, or duplicated, used in whole or in part for any purpose other than its intended purpose. Any use or disclosure in whole or in part of this information without explicit written permission of Stellantis is prohibited.<br>© 2024, Stellantis Ltd.<\/td><\/tr><\/table><\/div><p><strong>       <\/strong><\/p><p><strong>Target Audience<\/strong><\/p><p>ICT Personnel who want to integrate existing Dealer/Repairer facing functionalities / applications siloed within regional portals or create a Greenfield application to be delivered uniformly from new Global Portal Experience.<\/p><div class=\"tablewrap\"><table><tr><td>Date<\/td><td>Version<\/td><td>Status<\/td><td>Author(s)<\/td><td>Reviewer<\/td><td>Department<\/td><td>Notes<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><strong>2<\/strong><strong>4<\/strong><strong>th<\/strong><strong> <\/strong><strong>Jan<\/strong><strong> 202<\/strong><strong>5<\/strong><\/td><td>1.0<\/td><td>Presented to GDRP Stakeholders<\/td><td>Akshat S, Balaji,<br>Rohit Kumar<\/td><td>Mikita P,<br>Gaia I,<br>Vimala J,<br>Kumar K,<br>Alexander R<\/td><td>ICT<\/td><td>Draft document structure<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><strong>31<\/strong><strong>st<\/strong><strong> Jan 202<\/strong><strong>5<\/strong><\/td><td>1.1<\/td><td><\/td><td>Akshat S, Balaji M,<br>Rohit K,<br>Mihul N<\/td><td>Mikita P,<br>Gaia I,<br>Vimala J,<br>Kumar K,<br>Alexander R<\/td><td>ICT<\/td><td>-<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><strong>30th May 2025<\/strong><\/td><td>1.2<\/td><td><\/td><td>Mihul N<\/td><td>Mikita P,<br>Kumar K,<br>Vimala J<\/td><td>ICT<\/td><td><\/td><\/tr><tr><td><strong>7<\/strong><strong>th<\/strong><strong> Oct 2026<\/strong><\/td><td>1.3<\/td><td>Updated for RFQ<\/td><td>Matt Regan<\/td><td><\/td><td>ICT<\/td><td><\/td><\/tr><\/table><\/div>", "text": "\nGDRP SDK Guidelines\nOctober 7th, 2025\nVersion 1.3\nStatement of Confidentiality\nThis document contains information that is proprietary and confidential to Stellantis, which shall not be disclosed outside Stellantis, transmitted, or duplicated, used in whole or in part for any purpose other than its intended purpose. Any use or disclosure in whole or in part of this information without explicit written permission of Stellantis is prohibited.\n© 2024, Stellantis Ltd.\n       \nTarget Audience\nICT Personnel who want to integrate existing Dealer/Repairer facing functionalities / applications siloed within regional portals or create a Greenfield application to be delivered uniformly from new Global Portal Experience.\nDate\nVersion\nStatus\nAuthor(s)\nReviewer\nDepartment\nNotes\n24th Jan 2025\n1.0\nPresented to GDRP Stakeholders\nAkshat S, Balaji,\nRohit Kumar\nMikita P,\nGaia I,\nVimala J,\nKumar K,\nAlexander R\nICT\nDraft document structure\n31st Jan 2025\n1.1\n\nAkshat S, Balaji M,\nRohit K,\nMihul N\nMikita P,\nGaia I,\nVimala J,\nKumar K,\nAlexander R\nICT\n-\n30th May 2025\n1.2\n\nMihul N\nMikita P,\nKumar K,\nVimala J\nICT\n\n7th Oct 2026\n1.3\nUpdated for RFQ\nMatt Regan\n\nICT\n"}, {"id": "d2-s2", "doc": 2, "title": "A background on Dealer & Repairer of Stellantis", "html": "<p>Stellantis as we know today is a multi-national automotive organization that operates multiple brands - combining R&amp;D, manufacturing &amp; global distribution capabilities. Before Stellantis, 2 organization that operated independently were – FCA (Fiat Chrysler Automobiles) &amp; PSA (Peugeot Société Anonyme, better known as Groupe PSA). <\/p><p>Brands under FCA included:<\/p><p><strong>Chrysler<\/strong>, <strong>Dodge<\/strong>, <strong>Jeep<\/strong>, <strong>Ram<\/strong><strong>, MOPAR<\/strong> (American brands, also referred to xF-NA brands)<\/p><p><strong>Fiat<\/strong>, <strong>Alfa Romeo<\/strong>, <strong>Lancia<\/strong>, <strong>Maserati<\/strong> (Italian brands, also referred to as xF-EE brands)<\/p><p>Brands under PSA (also referred to as xP brands) included:<\/p><p><strong>Peugeot<\/strong>, <strong>Citroën<\/strong>, <strong>DS Automobiles<\/strong>, <strong>Opel<\/strong><strong>, <\/strong><strong>Vauxhall <\/strong>(later 2 acquired from General Motors)<\/p><p>One of the critical division of the traditional automotive industry is <strong>Dealer Network Organization<\/strong>, serving as the primary interface between vehicle manufacturers and customers. It consists of a structured network of authorized dealerships that handle the sales, service, and support of a manufacturer&#x27;s vehicles.<\/p><p>Another faction of the automotive industry is “Right to Repair” advocates. In the automotive world, &quot;right to repair&quot; generally refers to the principle that vehicle owners and independent repair shops should have access to the necessary information, tools, and parts to diagnose, maintain, and repair vehicles same as authorized dealers. This principle ensures that everyone can access the necessary parts and tools to perform repairs - both original equipment manufacturer (OEM) parts and aftermarket parts. <\/p><p>The right to repair protects consumers&#x27; freedom to choose where they have their vehicle serviced, whether it&#x27;s an independent shop, a dealership, or even their own driveway.<\/p><p>Currently Stellantis Dealers &amp; Repairers have access to OEM processes by regional Dealer Portals as enumerated below: <\/p><p>American Brands – DealerCONNECT (https://dealerconnect.chrysler.com)<\/p><p>Italian Brands – Link.e.Entry (https://linkentry.fiat.com)<\/p><p>PSA brands – Multiple purpose built portal to name a few – Customer360 (https://www.customer360psa.com), Service Box Independent Operator Portal (POI) (https://public.servicebox.peugeot.com), ServiceBox Authorized Repairer (https://servicebox.mpsa.com), MOVE remarketing portal (https://move.peugeot.com), Eurorepar Car Service Portal (https://ercs.servicebox-parts.com/) <\/p><p>As well as more country specific solutions that are also used:<\/p><p>WeConnect (individual urls per brand i.e. https://we.peugeot.com)<\/p><p>FCA Dealer Tool (https://www.fcadealertool.it/brands)<\/p><p>C-You (individual urls per brand - Citroen &gt; https://cyou.youconnecto.it/, Peugeot &gt; https://wemotion.youconnecto.it/, Opel &gt; https://opelink.youconnecto.it/, DS &gt; https://dsinsiders.youconnecto.it/, Fiat &gt;  https://heyfiat.youconnecto.it/) <\/p><p>Connect-D (https://connect.stellantis.co.uk)<\/p><p>SalesWeb and StellantisInfo<\/p><p>Above Portals served well by delivering Sales, Services &amp; Parts, Training, Communication for Dealer Organization when these dealerships were selling &amp; servicing respective brands of erstwhile organization.<\/p><p>With Stellantis Dare Forward 2030 vision of positioning the combined organization to lead in sustainable mobility, combining innovation, customer-centricity, and operational excellence to shape the future of transportation – there is a need for Global Expansion by revamping the existing Dealership to become multi-brand outlet/agencies. In simpler terms, the erstwhile Dealership selling Peugeot brand would soon also become sales centre for Jeep brand or After-sales/Service centre for FIAT brand would also service a customer of Citroen brand.<\/p><p>Selling multiple automotive brands from a single dealership presents operational benefits but also introduces significant challenges, especially when it comes to accessing and using multiple dealer portals—one for each brand. Below are the main challenges dealers face:<\/p><p><strong>1. Fragmented Systems and User Experience<\/strong><\/p><p>Different logins, interfaces, and navigation for each brand’s portal lead to inefficiency.<\/p><p>Staff must learn and remember multiple systems, increasing training time and risk of error.<\/p><p><strong>2. Inconsistent Data Integration<\/strong><\/p><p>Customer, inventory, and service data often can’t be shared across portals.<\/p><p>Dealers must duplicate entries or manually sync information between systems, increasing workload and error potential.<\/p><p><strong>3. Increased Administrative Overhead<\/strong><\/p><p>Managing multiple credentials, permissions, and compliance checks for each brand increases IT and admin burden.<\/p><p>Updates and maintenance vary per portal, making it harder to maintain consistency.<\/p><p><strong>4. Slower Customer Service<\/strong><\/p><p>Switching between portals to check inventory, service history, or warranty status across brands delays customer interactions.<\/p><p>Customers may expect seamless service regardless of the brand, but the backend systems don’t support it.<\/p><p><strong>5. Training Complexity<\/strong><\/p><p>Sales and service teams must be trained on the tools and standards of each brand, complicating onboarding and reducing specialization.<\/p><p><strong>6. Limited Cross-Selling Efficiency<\/strong><\/p><p>Lack of centralized tools makes it harder to recommend alternative brand models quickly or show cross-brand promotions and offers.<\/p><p>These challenges reduce operational efficiency and customer &amp; dealer satisfaction. To mitigate them, Stellantis has embarked on various initiative within Dealer Network Organization to synergize the Business Process &amp; Technology Landscape invested &amp; locked in selling &amp; servicing products across these brands. One of the important initiatives is consolidation of Dealer &amp; Distribution Network of Stellantis by creating a Global Dealer Data Platform – a program called as “<strong>Single Network Referential<\/strong>”. As a stepping stone for mitigating Dealers &amp; Repairers challenges listed previously would be to create a Reusable Component Engineering Platform – a program called as “<strong>Global Dealer &amp; Repairer <\/strong><strong>Platform (GDRP)<\/strong>” branded as “<strong>The Dealer Experience<\/strong>” portal that can interface with existing portals/applications of individual brands and unify access.<\/p>", "text": "Stellantis as we know today is a multi-national automotive organization that operates multiple brands - combining R&D, manufacturing & global distribution capabilities. Before Stellantis, 2 organization that operated independently were – FCA (Fiat Chrysler Automobiles) & PSA (Peugeot Société Anonyme, better known as Groupe PSA). \nBrands under FCA included:\nChrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram, MOPAR (American brands, also referred to xF-NA brands)\nFiat, Alfa Romeo, Lancia, Maserati (Italian brands, also referred to as xF-EE brands)\nBrands under PSA (also referred to as xP brands) included:\nPeugeot, Citroën, DS Automobiles, Opel, Vauxhall (later 2 acquired from General Motors)\nOne of the critical division of the traditional automotive industry is Dealer Network Organization, serving as the primary interface between vehicle manufacturers and customers. It consists of a structured network of authorized dealerships that handle the sales, service, and support of a manufacturer's vehicles.\nAnother faction of the automotive industry is “Right to Repair” advocates. In the automotive world, \"right to repair\" generally refers to the principle that vehicle owners and independent repair shops should have access to the necessary information, tools, and parts to diagnose, maintain, and repair vehicles same as authorized dealers. This principle ensures that everyone can access the necessary parts and tools to perform repairs - both original equipment manufacturer (OEM) parts and aftermarket parts. \nThe right to repair protects consumers' freedom to choose where they have their vehicle serviced, whether it's an independent shop, a dealership, or even their own driveway.\nCurrently Stellantis Dealers & Repairers have access to OEM processes by regional Dealer Portals as enumerated below: \nAmerican Brands – DealerCONNECT (https://dealerconnect.chrysler.com)\nItalian Brands – Link.e.Entry (https://linkentry.fiat.com)\nPSA brands – Multiple purpose built portal to name a few – Customer360 (https://www.customer360psa.com), Service Box Independent Operator Portal (POI) (https://public.servicebox.peugeot.com), ServiceBox Authorized Repairer (https://servicebox.mpsa.com), MOVE remarketing portal (https://move.peugeot.com), Eurorepar Car Service Portal (https://ercs.servicebox-parts.com/) \nAs well as more country specific solutions that are also used:\nWeConnect (individual urls per brand i.e. https://we.peugeot.com)\nFCA Dealer Tool (https://www.fcadealertool.it/brands)\nC-You (individual urls per brand - Citroen > https://cyou.youconnecto.it/, Peugeot > https://wemotion.youconnecto.it/, Opel > https://opelink.youconnecto.it/, DS > https://dsinsiders.youconnecto.it/, Fiat >  https://heyfiat.youconnecto.it/) \nConnect-D (https://connect.stellantis.co.uk)\nSalesWeb and StellantisInfo\nAbove Portals served well by delivering Sales, Services & Parts, Training, Communication for Dealer Organization when these dealerships were selling & servicing respective brands of erstwhile organization.\nWith Stellantis Dare Forward 2030 vision of positioning the combined organization to lead in sustainable mobility, combining innovation, customer-centricity, and operational excellence to shape the future of transportation – there is a need for Global Expansion by revamping the existing Dealership to become multi-brand outlet/agencies. In simpler terms, the erstwhile Dealership selling Peugeot brand would soon also become sales centre for Jeep brand or After-sales/Service centre for FIAT brand would also service a customer of Citroen brand.\nSelling multiple automotive brands from a single dealership presents operational benefits but also introduces significant challenges, especially when it comes to accessing and using multiple dealer portals—one for each brand. Below are the main challenges dealers face:\n1. Fragmented Systems and User Experience\nDifferent logins, interfaces, and navigation for each brand’s portal lead to inefficiency.\nStaff must learn and remember multiple systems, increasing training time and risk of error.\n2. Inconsistent Data Integration\nCustomer, inventory, and service data often can’t be shared across portals.\nDealers must duplicate entries or manually sync information between systems, increasing workload and error potential.\n3. Increased Administrative Overhead\nManaging multiple credentials, permissions, and compliance checks for each brand increases IT and admin burden.\nUpdates and maintenance vary per portal, making it harder to maintain consistency.\n4. Slower Customer Service\nSwitching between portals to check inventory, service history, or warranty status across brands delays customer interactions.\nCustomers may expect seamless service regardless of the brand, but the backend systems don’t support it.\n5. Training Complexity\nSales and service teams must be trained on the tools and standards of each brand, complicating onboarding and reducing specialization.\n6. Limited Cross-Selling Efficiency\nLack of centralized tools makes it harder to recommend alternative brand models quickly or show cross-brand promotions and offers.\nThese challenges reduce operational efficiency and customer & dealer satisfaction. To mitigate them, Stellantis has embarked on various initiative within Dealer Network Organization to synergize the Business Process & Technology Landscape invested & locked in selling & servicing products across these brands. One of the important initiatives is consolidation of Dealer & Distribution Network of Stellantis by creating a Global Dealer Data Platform – a program called as “Single Network Referential”. As a stepping stone for mitigating Dealers & Repairers challenges listed previously would be to create a Reusable Component Engineering Platform – a program called as “Global Dealer & Repairer Platform (GDRP)” branded as “The Dealer Experience” portal that can interface with existing portals/applications of individual brands and unify access."}, {"id": "d2-s3", "doc": 2, "title": "Abstract of regional Portal", "html": "<p>In a very simplistic representation, a Portal is really a suite of Web-enabled applications that can be accessed by a common gateway of components such IAM (Authentication &amp; Authorization), UAM (User Access Management – Roles &amp; Profiles), Monitoring, Logging, Session Management, Uniform Look &amp; Feel delivering seamless experience while a user navigates from one application to another within the Portal Boundary. <\/p><p>For e.g. Automotive vehicle sales are enhanced through integrated applications that manage <strong>vehicle inventory, incentives, and service contracts<\/strong>.
